programme.title: Żużel: PGE Ekstraliga - rewanżowy mecz finałowy fazy play-off: Betard Sparta Wrocław - PRES Grupa Deweloperska Toruń
programme.desc: Panowanie Motoru Lublin w Ekstralidze trwało trzy lata i dobiegło końca w 2025 roku za sprawą toruńskich Aniołów. Ekipa ta jest na dobrej drodze, by też zapisać się złotymi zgłoskami w annałach rodzimego żużla. Pierwsza część finałowego dwumeczu pomiędzy PRES-em Toruń i Spartą Wrocław rozpoczęła się z dwugodzinnym opóźnieniem z powodu opadów deszczu. Obie drużyny zrekompensowały jednak kibicom oczekiwanie i zafundowały im świetne widowisko. Ostatecznie gospodarze wygrali 55:35 i do stolicy Dolnego Śląska pojadą dopełnić dzieła. Szóste mistrzostwo Polski w historii klubu z Miasta Pierników jest więc na wyciągnięcie ręki Patryka Dudka i jego kolegów. W meczu na Motoarenie zawiódł zwłaszcza Maciej Janowski, który zdobył dla Sparty tylko 4 punkty. Doświadczony zawodnik w wywiadach nie ukrywał, że jego drużyna jest w bardzo trudnej sytuacji przed rewanżem. Ma jednak powody, by wierzyć w sukces swojej misji. W sezonie zasadniczym Wrocławianie ograli Torunian na Stadionie Olimpijskim 52:38. Ponadto w 2026 roku pozostają niepokonani przed własną publicznością. Przy znakomitej dyspozycji wszystkich żużlowców i odrobinie szczęścia są więc w stanie odwrócić losy finałowej rywalizacji i po pięcioletniej przerwie wrócić na ekstraligowy tron.

programme.title: Negócio Fechado
programme.desc: Em 'Negócio Fechado', Eduardo Alves Marques e Tânia Ribas de Oliveira avaliam antiguidades e colecionáveis, desvendando as suas histórias e valor. Os proprietários, então, confrontam um painel de compradores, incluindo Álvaro Roquette e Batata Cerqueira Gomes, numa negociação que visa o melhor negócio. O programa cativa o público pela emoção das histórias humanas, a curiosidade pelas origens das peças e o suspense das transações.

programme.title: O Preço Certo
programme.desc: Há mais de duas décadas em emissão contínua na RTP1, "O Preço Certo", é o gameshow de maior longevidade da televisão mundial. Estreado pela primeira vez em 1956 nos Estados Unidos, já foi transmitido em mais de 30 países. O sucesso por todo o mundo é testemunho da sua contínua popularidade e vitalidade, provando ser um clássico e intemporal formato de programas de entretenimento. Estreado em 2002 com o nome "O Preço Certo em Euros", para familiarizar os portugueses com a nova moeda, foi primeiro apresentado por Jorge Gabriel e depois por Fernando Mendes, sempre com Miguel Vital a dar voz aos fabulosos prémios. Em 2006 foi relançado com o nome original de O Preço Certo mantendo o apresentador e toda a boa disposição.

programme.title: Grande Reportagem RTP
programme.sub-title: Arménia, Entre a Memória e o Futuro
programme.desc: Em vésperas de uma Cimeira da ONU, a Arménia enfrenta graves desafios ambientais. A pesca excessiva no lago Sevan e as alterações climáticas ameaçam o país com seca, afetando até as vinhas do vale do monte Ararat. Garantir a sustentabilidade dos ecossistemas é crucial para esta nação milenar. A reportagem da RTP, "Arménia, Entre a Memória e o Futuro", documenta estas dificuldades e os esforços locais para as superar.

De seguida, os vendedores negociam com um painel de experientes compradores, como Álvaro Roquette e Batata Cerqueira Gomes, que fazem as suas propostas. O programa promete suspense, emoção e a descoberta do destino de tesouros surpreendentes.

programme.title: Televendas
programme.desc: Todos os dias, um espaço dedicado a vendas por televisão, em que são feitas demonstrações dos produtos.

programme.title: 24 Horas
programme.desc: Bloco noticioso com um olhar para o dia que termina, marcando claramente a atualidade do novo dia que começa. Neste espaço de informação têm também destaque os principais eventos culturais do país, com as opiniões de quem os constrói e daqueles que estiveram na plateia.

programme.title: Bom Dia Portugal
programme.desc: Porque é de manhã que se começa o dia, então inicie-o na nossa companhia! Todos os dias, o «Bom dia Portugal» dedica espaços específicos às notícias da atualidade nacional e internacional, desporto, meteorologia, trânsito e economia.

programme.title: Praça da Alegria
programme.desc: Jorge Gabriel e Sónia Araújo dão-lhe as boas vindas à Praça da Alegria! Porque sabemos que gosta da nossa companhia, oferecemos boa disposição até à hora de almoço! De segunda a sexta-feira, a Praça da Alegria leva até si a melhor música, as últimas tendências da moda, conselhos úteis e muitas dicas que facilitam o seu dia-a-dia. Portugal inteiro marca presença nesta Praça da Alegria com reportagens e diretos onde ficamos mais perto de si!

programme.title: Jornal da Tarde
programme.desc: Todos os dias, às 13 horas, a sua hora de almoço é completada com a atualização das notícias que marcam a atualidade nacional e mundial, desde a política, a economia, a sociedade e sem esquecer o desporto. Reportagens no local, entrevistas em direto e sempre a isenção e o respeito pela verdade que marcam a informação na RTP.

programme.title: A Escrava Isaura
programme.desc: Rosa fica triste por o seu pai não conseguir arranjar-lhe um casamento. Álvaro expulsa os capitães do mato. Leôncio chega a casa de Branca e Tomásia, à de Álvaro. Moleca regressa ao quilombo. Álvaro diz a Tomásia que ela verá Isaura após uma visita a Geraldo.

programme.title: Negócio Fechado
programme.desc: "Negócio Fechado" desvenda as histórias e o potencial valor de antiguidades e objetos de coleção. Eduardo Alves Marques, com Tânia Ribas de Oliveira, avalia e explora a origem de cada peça. Segue-se uma negociação com um painel de compradores (incluindo Roquette, Marques e Cerqueira Gomes), que fazem as suas propostas. O programa cativa pela curiosidade sobre as peças e o suspense da busca pelo melhor negócio.

programme.title: Agarra-me Se Puderes
programme.desc: Agarra-me Se Puderes desafia concorrentes de todo o país a colocarem à prova os seus conhecimentos numa corrida contra o tempo pela conquista do prémio final. O concurso combina cultura geral e competição num formato divertido para toda a família, com o anfitrião José Pedro Vasconcelos.

programme.title: Portugal em Rede
programme.desc: O Portugal que existe para além das grandes cidades, do norte ao sul e às ilhas, numa verdadeira rede de informação. Inclui um segmento dedicado à língua portuguesa e à sua promoção "Esta língua que nos une". Os Centros de Informação Regional terão uma participação relevante neste espaço.

programme.title: O Preço Certo
programme.desc: Há mais de duas décadas em emissão contínua na RTP1, "O Preço Certo", é o gameshow de maior longevidade da televisão mundial. Estreado pela primeira vez em 1956 nos Estados Unidos, já foi transmitido em mais de 30 países. O sucesso por todo o mundo é testemunho da sua contínua popularidade e vitalidade, provando ser um clássico e intemporal formato de programas de entretenimento. Estreado em 2002 com o nome "O Preço Certo em Euros", para familiarizar os portugueses com a nova moeda, foi primeiro apresentado por Jorge Gabriel e depois por Fernando Mendes, sempre com Miguel Vital a dar voz aos fabulosos prémios. Em 2006 foi relançado com o nome original de O Preço Certo mantendo o apresentador e toda a boa disposição.

programme.title: Direito de Antena
programme.desc: Espaço da responsabilidade das entidades intervenientes. Destina-se essencialmente à divulgação de campanhas políticas, de solidariedade ou outras associações de caráter diverso.

programme.title: Telejornal
programme.desc: A mais rigorosa seleção de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. De segunda a domingo, João Adelino Faria, José Rodrigues dos Santos, Cristina Esteves e Ana Lourenço mostram-lhe o que de mais relevante se passou o país e no mundo. Se é importante está no Telejornal.

programme.title: A Prova dos Factos
programme.desc: Procurar a verdade, obriga a confrontar, investigar, perguntar... Estes são tempos de muitas opiniões e diferentes ângulos sobre os factos. E em cada investigação, só os Factos nos interessam. A verdade só chega quando se faz A Prova dos Factos e ela faz-se, agora, todas as sextas-feiras, na RTP.

programme.title: Joker
programme.desc: Vasco Palmeirim apresenta o JOKER, o concurso favorito dos portugueses. Um concorrente, com a ajuda de 7 Jokers e do Super Joker, responde a 12 perguntas com um só objetivo em mente: Conquistar os 50 000 euros do prémio máximo!

programme.title: Em Casa d'Amália
programme.desc: É tempo de regressar à "Casa d'Amália", com novos protagonistas, novos cruzamentos, nova envolvência. Um programa que já é uma referência no panorama musical em Portugal. A 11a temporada traz a mesma filosofia de sempre: promover um encontro entre músicos, poetas, artistas, radialistas, em torno do Fado.

programme.title: Espias
programme.desc: Miss Black está determinada em encontar a toupeira da embaixada inglesa. Entretanto, William Larenz encontra-se com Rose, comunicando novos resultados de uma das suas mais bem-sucedidas espias, Ema Delmont, que gere uma complexa rede de espionagem na Europa.

programme.desc: Passaram dez anos desde que o doutor Hannibal Lecter fugiu dos seus guardiães, depois de ter sido entrevistado pela agente do FBI Clarice Starling (interpretada magistralmente por Jodie Foster) num hospital de máxima segurança para criminais alien...

programme.desc: Quando Jen Kornfeldt decide ceder aos caprichos dos seus pais, aceitando juntar-se a eles numa longa viagem pela costa francesa, não imaginava como a sua vida seria alterada.

programme.title: O Coleccionador de Ossos
programme.desc: Um diabólico assassino anda à solta nas ruas de Manhattan. Os seus brutais homicídios deixam um rasto de mensagens em código escondidas no local do crime, pistas que somente uma mente brilhante pode resolver.

programme.title: Cães Danados
programme.desc: Joe Cabot (Lawrence Tierney), um experiente criminoso, reuniu seis bandidos para um grande roubo de diamantes, mas estes seis homens não sabem nada um sobre os outros e cada um utiliza uma cor como codinome.

programme.title: Pompeia
programme.desc: Agosto de 79 d.C.. Pompeia. Milo é hoje um escravo que, devido à sua força de carácter e compleição física, se tornou um dos mais famosos gladiadores da cidade.

programme.desc: Ben Stiller é Greenberg - solteiro, de quarenta e tal anos, que nada faz deliberadamente - nesta comédia inteligente, engraçada e comovente que os críticos dizem ser extremamente divertida.

programme.desc: Este retrato complexo da incomparável Whitney Houston acompanha a ascensão da cantora desde menina do coro em Nova Jérsia até estrela internacional.

programme.title: Ponto de Mira
programme.desc: O presidente dos E.U.A viaja a salamanca para dar uma conferência. Durante o evento, alguém o tenta matar. A história é contada através dos olhos de oito testemunhas, oito versões diferentes da mesma situação.

programme.desc: Um antigo cantor de rock aparece brutalmente assassinado na sua cama. O agente Nick Curran é encarregue da vigilância da noiva da vítima, Catherine Tramell, uma atractiva escritora bem sucedida na sua vida profissional e principal suspeita do crime.

programme.title: Push - Os Poderosos

programme.title: O Universo no Olhar
programme.desc: Um biólogo molecular e o companheiro de laboratório descobrem evidências que podem alterar a sociedade tal como a conhecemos.

programme.title: Kill Bill - A Vingança
programme.desc: Quatro anos após ser baleada na cabeça, no dia do próprio casamento, «a noiva» acorda do coma e decide que é tempo de alguém pagar as contas... Com uma terrível vingança!

programme.title: Kill Bill - A Vingança (Vol.2)
programme.desc: Já com dois nomes riscados da lista de morte, «a noiva» regressa para tratar de Budd e Elle Driver, os únicos sobreviventes do bando de assassinos que a traiu, quatro anos antes. Mas a possibilidade de a filha ainda estar viva pode alterar os planos.

programme.title: Alien: O Regresso
programme.desc: Ripley morreu a lutar com um predador mortal. Anos mais tarde ela está de volta num clone na esperança de criar a arma perfeita! Mas a nova Ripley está pronta a surpreender os seus "criadores". E rapidamente o terror invade a nave que os transporta.

programme.title: Um Homem no Limite
programme.desc: Nick Cassidy era um polícia honesto, até ser preso por um crime que cometeu. Desesperado, consegue fugir e sobe a um arranha-céus, de onde ameaça atirar-se. Enquanto fala com a negociadora da Polícia, ninguém imagina que tudo faz parte de um golpe...

programme.title: Sócios à Força
programme.desc: Nick Lang é uma famosa estrela de cinema que alia forças com um detetive nova-iorquino valentão, John Moss, para se emancipar da imagem de “bom rapaz” que cunhou no ecrã.

programme.title: Voz de Cama
programme.desc: A psicóloga-sexóloga Tânia Graça responde às dúvidas dos ouvintes da Antena da 3 e conversa com Ana Markl, o podcast agora disponível na RTP2.

programme.sub-title: O Homem da Câmara de Filmar
programme.desc: Uma reflexão com linguagem despretensiosa, a análise sobre o contexto cultural e artístico de alguns filmes importantes da história mundial do Cinema.

programme.title: Remo: Campeonato Do Mundo De Remo De Praia (Direto)
programme.desc: Campeonato do Mundo de Remo de Praia decorre de 18 a 21 de outubro de 2026 em Qingdao, na China.

programme.title: Sociedade Civil
programme.desc: O Sociedade Civil é um programa com História que quer fazer cada vez mais parte do dia-a-dia de todos os portugueses. São questões públicas debatidas por gente distinta, temas particulares apresentados de forma clara. Apresentado pelo jornalista Luís Castro, de segunda a sexta-feira, às 14h00.

programme.title: Molang
programme.desc: Molang é uma série infantil com um olhar afetuoso e bem-humorado sobre a amizade entre um coelho excêntrico, alegre e entusiasta e Piu Piu, um pintainho tímido, discreto e sentimental.

programme.title: Cadetes
programme.desc: Os nossos amigos são cadetes espaciais, exploradores em formação numa academia espacial de uma escola de jogos no planeta WotWot. Nessa academia, os cinco amigos aprendem e brincam juntos, mas cada um tem uma área de interesse especial como arte ou ciência.

programme.title: Kiri e Lou
programme.desc: Numa floresta de papel recortado e com criaturas feitas de argila, Kiri, um pequeno dinossauro mal-humorado com emoções avassaladoras e Lou, uma criatura gentil e atenciosa, podem parecer os melhores amigos mais improváveis.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing Bunny é uma série baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pré-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.title: Jasmine e Jambo
programme.desc: Jasmine e Jambo são loucos por música. Eles vivem em Soundland, uma terra divertida e surreal onde a música e a vida andam de mãos dadas.

programme.title: Pirata & Capitão
programme.desc: Ser pirata e capitão é uma busca sem fim por tesouros, viver grandes aventuras, diversão e espírito de equipa.

programme.title: Mouk

A produção levanta questões éticas sobre esta intervenção humana e o seu impacto, questionando se estamos a "brincar aos deuses".

programme.desc: Radar XS é um telejornal para crianças dos 8 aos 12 anos onde se pretende incentivar o pensamento crítico e a cidadania consciente. Vamos juntar a política e a cultura, a economia e desporto, a ciência e a literatura infantil, a atualidade nacional e internacional numa linguagem simples e objetiva.

programme.title: O Leonel das Moscas

programme.title: Vencidos
programme.desc: Uma entrevista a uma mulher admirável. A primeira governante cega em Portugal. Licenciada em Direito, advogada. Ex-presidente da ACAPO e secretária de Estado durante oito anos, Ana Sofia Antunes é a política que mais fez inclusão pelos portugueses com deficiência.

programme.title: Catatuas-Negras em Risco de Vida
programme.desc: As icónicas catatuas-negras da Austrália Ocidental estão à beira da extinção, com três espécies em risco de desaparecer em 20 anos. A perda crítica de habitats, como os bosques de banksia para as de Carnaby, o abate por agricultores das de Baudin, e a escassez de locais de nidificação para as de cauda-vermelha, criam um cenário dramático. Este documentário explora a sua situação desesperada e a corrida contra o tempo para as salvar.

programme.desc: Verão de 1939: O engenheiro Wernher von Braun é forçado a desenvolver armas para a Alemanha nazi com o eclodir da Segunda Guerra Mundial, enquanto Joan Hinton explora a física nuclear nos EUA, consciente do seu potencial destrutivo. A invasão da Polónia intensifica a crise de refugiados, levando Golda Meir a lutar pela aceitação de judeus na Palestina britânica, recorrendo a medidas extremas perante a recusa.

programme.title: O Último Capítulo
programme.desc: O envelhecimento de imigrantes longe da sua pátria levanta questões profundas sobre identidade e pertença. A vida de Justine, Sisto e Ben Allal na Finlândia ilustra as complexas lutas diárias e emocionais, marcadas por doença, solidão e memórias esbatidas. Apesar dos desafios, a sua inabalável vontade de viver sustenta-os, revelando as dificuldades de encarar o último capítulo da vida longe das suas raízes.

programme.title: Zoe e Milo
programme.desc: Zoe e Milo são duas crianças de dez anos. Eles não são apenas vizinhos que vivem numa cidade grande, são os melhores amigos. E também são aventureiros: viajam pelo mundo num avião construído e pilotado por Alim, um hamster.

programme.title: Index
programme.desc: Com duas temáticas diferentes por dia, o "Index" é um quizz que coloca o espectador à prova e ainda dá a conhecer várias curiosidades.

programme.title: Esec-tv
programme.desc: Um programa integralmente produzido por profissionais, alunos e estagiários da licenciatura em Comunicação Social, contando com a colaboração de estudantes de outras licenciaturas da ESEC.

programme.title: A Floresta
programme.desc: Quando o conceituado ecologista Tom Crowther estimou que o nosso planeta tem espaço para mais um trilião de árvores, que poderiam absorver carbono suficiente para abrandar as alterações climáticas, a notícia foi destaque em todo o mundo. Infelizmente, isto levou empresas e governos a plantarem florestas em monocultura, que não têm a diversidade biológica das florestas naturais, em vez de reduzirem as emissões. Perante a reação negativa de outros cientistas, Tom e a sua equipa trabalharam para esclarecer a situação e encontrar uma nova solução. Utilizando um avançado modelo computacional, Tom fez descobertas impressionantes, como por exemplo que as florestas mais antigas e diversificadas podem armazenar quase o dobro do carbono em relação às novas plantações e que os fungos e os animais desempenham um papel crucial. Para além da redução das emissões, será que restaurar a plena saúde das florestas existentes, e regenerar as florestas perdidas, pode ser a chave para combater as alterações climáticas?

programme.title: O Eclipse
programme.desc: Quando os investigadores pensam ter encontrado o culpado, uma reviravolta inesperada muda completamente o cenário. Apesar das suspeitas de David, Manue e Johanna recusam-se a acreditar que Angèle e Luca tenham tido qualquer envolvimento no crime.

programme.title: Folha de Sala
programme.desc: Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, não esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realização de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferências. Texto e locução de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: A Fé dos Homens
programme.desc: Espaço dedicado às diferentes religiões reconhecidas em Portugal e instituídas através de uma Igreja própria.

programme.title: Histórias da Linha de Sintra
programme.sub-title: A Praça da Esperança (Lívio de Morais)
programme.desc: Com décadas de dedicação à arte, à docência e à política, Lívio de Morais conduz-nos à escola em que lecionou, em Agualva-Cacém, e à Casa da Cultura que recebe o seu nome desde 2015, em Mira Sintra.

programme.title: Sociedade Civil
programme.desc: O Sociedade Civil é um programa com História que quer fazer cada vez mais parte do dia-a-dia de todos os portugueses. São questões públicas debatidas por gente distinta, temas particulares apresentados de forma clara. Apresentado pelo jornalista Luís Castro, de segunda a sexta-feira, às 14h00.

programme.title: Solteira e Boa Rapariga
programme.desc: Lourenço é viajado, resolvido e solteiríssimo. Tudo o que Carla sonhou encontrar. O amor é alimento para a alma, mas, para Lourenço, a alimentação é mais importante que o amor.

programme.title: Solteira e Boa Rapariga
programme.desc: Bernardo vive num apartamento luxuoso, rodeado de obras de arte. Charmoso, educado, cavalheiro, é o tipo de homem de quem todas as sogras gostam. As narrativas de viagem seduzem a nossa solteira, que já se imagina a viver naquele luxo.

programme.title: Terra: Histórias da Cerâmica
programme.desc: A roda de oleiro é um espelho que devolve o momento presente. Assim vai Ricardo Lopes encontrando o seu lugar no mundo, entre a biologia, a olaria, a música e as viagens.

programme.title: Folha de Sala
programme.desc: Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, não esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realização de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferências. Texto e locução de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: Gabinete de Curiosidades
programme.desc: No "Gabinete de Curiosidades" são apresentados vários curiosidades culturais e históricas. De frases intrigantes, à análise de filmes, de pessoas interessantes, a lugares inesperados.

programme.title: Kiwi
programme.desc: Vamos aprender Inglês com Twiki e Twini! Cada episódio será uma aventura para descobrir novas palavras e novos sons.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Os Numberblocks são um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vão ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing Bunny é uma série baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pré-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.title: A Ovelha Choné
programme.desc: Ovelha Choné? Pois esta ovelha é um pouco excêntrica, como o nome indica! Aventuras cheias de humor na quinta, sob a supervisão do Agricultor e de Bitzer, o cão pastor.

programme.title: Dinoster: Os Heróis Quânticos
programme.desc: Acompanha as aventuras de quatro amigos que aparentam levar uma vida normal, mas viajam em segredo para a Dino Terra para estudar os dinossauros e salvá-los do perigo. É a equipa Dinoster!

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lemingues
programme.desc: Numa vasta reserva natural localizada no meio da floresta selvagem, há um pequeno núcleo de civilização humana: a casa do guarda-florestal.

programme.title: Academia de Super-Heróis
programme.desc: Um grupo de adolescentes frequenta uma escola especial para futuros super-heróis onde tentam dominar pistas de obstáculos mortais e criar as suas próprias super-roupas!

programme.title: Campeonato do Mundo de Ginástica Artística - Concurso Completo Individual Feminino - Final
programme.desc: O Campeonato do Mundo de Ginástica Artística de 2026 decorre no Rotterdam Ahoy, em Roterdão, nos Países Baixos, de 17 a 25 de outubro e reúne os melhores ginastas masculinos e femininos do mundo, que competem por títulos nas provas por equipas, individuais gerais e aparelhos individuais.

programme.desc: O Jornal Nacional é marcado por um jornalismo atento e responsável, que se preocupa com os verdadeiros problemas do nosso tempo e das nossas vidas e os trata de forma profissional e séria. Conteúdo em língua gestual portuguesa (LGP).

programme.title: The Brain
programme.desc: Pela primeira vez, as maiores estrelas portuguesas dos Reality Shows vão enfrentar-se numa aventura completamente diferente.Desta vez, não basta ter charme, drama ou seguidores.Não há casa, praia nem romance.

programme.title: Big Brother All stars - Especial
programme.sub-title: Big Brother - Big Brother All Stars - Especial
programme.desc: Há 26 anos, Portugal parou para assistir à estreia do primeiro reality show do país. Desde então, muitos foram os concorrentes que fizeram história e conquistaram um lugar único na memória do público.Agora, os protagonistas estão de volta.

programme.title: Coração De Mãe
programme.desc: «Coração de Mãe» é a história de Linda, uma mulher na casa dos quarenta, simples, tão bonita quanto guerreira, que desespera ao ver o seu filho ir preso depois de a salvar das mãos de um marido violento.

programme.title: A Madrasta
programme.desc: Depois de vinte anos numa prisão em Marrocos, condenada injustamente por um crime que não cometeu, Diana Magalhães Neto regressa a Portugal decidida a recuperar os filhos e a provar a sua inocência.

programme.title: Terra Forte
programme.desc: Dada como morta no Brasil, Flor ressurge quase vinte anos depois nos Açores, trazendo uma revelação que pode mudar tudo: alguém tentou matá-la em alto-mar.

Elisa
Elisa di Rivombrosa
programme.desc:
Frumoasa Elisa Scalzi, dama de companie
a contesei Ristori, se îndrăgosteşte de fiul acesteia, Fabrizio. Din
păcate, diferenţa mare de rang şi de avere face imposibilă căsătoria
celor doi tineri. Intrigile familiei îi vor pune la încercare pe Elisa
şi Fabrizio, care vor trece prin nenumărate aventuri până să-şi
găsească fericirea. Dar, în cele din urmă, în ciuda diferenţelor
sociale şi a imixtiunilor celor răuvoitori, dragostea va iesi
triumfătoare.

programme.title: Sclava Isaura
A Escrava Isaura
programme.desc: Remake dupa cunoscuta serie din 1976, serialul se constituie intr-o tumultoasa istorie a vietii sclavei Isaura, o tanara de culoare alba.\n\nNascuta in 1885, la ferma comandantului Almeida din Campos, tanara Isaura este fiica frumoasei sclave Juliana si a administratorului fermei Miguel. programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Massachusetts doctor Louis Creed moves to a small Maine town with his wife Rachel, their kids, Ellie and Gage, and Church, the cat. While exploring the local woods, Ellie stumbles across a funeral procession of children taking a dead dog to a cemetery. Neighbour Jud Crandall warns the Creeds that the woods are dangerous, as they soon discover for themselves via the dark power of the local burial ground. Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A bank robber is bitten by a vampire, spelling trouble for his partners in crime, who find themselves trapped in their hideout with a bloodsucking terror. Horror sequel, starring Robert Patrick, Bo Hopkins, Duane Whitaker, Muse Watson and Tiffani-Amber Thiessen.

programme.title: Beast of War
programme.desc: A group of soldiers get stranded on a raft in the middle of the ocean after their ship is sunk, and must battle a great white shark. Writer/director Kiah Roache-Turner's horror thriller, starring Mark Coles Smith and Joel Nankervis.

programme.title: 47 Metres Down
programme.desc: Two sisters vacationing in Mexico are trapped in a shark cage at the bottom of the ocean. With less than an hour of oxygen left and great white sharks circling nearby, they must fight to survive. Horror, starring Mandy Moore, Claire Holt and Matthew Modine.

programme.title: Man Finds Tape
programme.desc: After finding mysterious video clips, siblings investigate the strange recordings and uncover a disturbing secret. Horror thriller, starring Kelsey Pribilski and William Magnuson.

programme.title: The Damned
programme.desc: A 19th-century widow must make an unimaginable choice when, during a cruel winter, a foreign ship sinks off the coast of her fishing village. Horror mystery, starring Odessa Young, Joe Cole, Siobhan Finneran and Rory McCann.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront. Supernatural mystery drama, starring Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson and Elliot Cowan.

programme.title: We Bury the Dead
programme.desc: When an experimental military weapon accidentally devastates Tasmania, volunteers travel to the island to help authorities identify the dead. Among them is a Ava Newman, who secretly hopes to find her missing husband. However, some of the bodies seem to be returning to life. Horror, starring Daisy Ridley, Brenton Thwaites and Mark Coles Smith.

programme.desc: In 1930s Chicago, maverick scientist Dr Euphronius gives life to a murdered woman, sparking romance, police interest and radical change. Writer/director Maggie Gyllenhaal's horror based on The Bride of Frankenstein, starring Jessie Buckley, Christian Bale and Annette Bening.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Four decades ago, Michael Myers terrorised the town of Haddonfield, Illinois and went on a killing spree, 15 years after murdering his sister. Director David Gordon Green's horror sequel based on John Carpenter's much imitated 1978 namesake movie, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Judy Greer and Andi Matichak.

programme.desc: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without trace. Eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them. Supernatural horror, starring Jack Reynor, Laia Costa, May Calamawy and Natalie Grace.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: Guitar technician Beth abandons life on tour to visit her estranged sister Ellie and three children, Bridget, Danny and Kassie. programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger.

programme.title: Weapons
programme.desc: At 2.17am, 17 children from the class of Justine Gandy run into the night, arms outstretched, never to be seen again. The only child from the class who remains safely in their bed is Alex Lilly. Distraught parent Archer Graff joins other members of the local community in pointing a finger of blame at Ms Gandy for the shocking turn of events. While she pleads innocence, school principal Andrew Marcus seeks answers along with police officer Paul Morgan. Horror, starring Julia Garner, Josh Brolin and Alden Ehrenreich.

programme.title: Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Three cowboy movie stars from the silent era -- Dusty Bottoms (Chevy Chase), Lucky Day (Steve Martin) and Ned Nederlander (Martin Short) -- are fired when one of their movies bombs. In what seems to be a career-saving offer, young Mexican woman Carmen (Patrice Martinez) offers them a high-paying gig in her village. The three jump at the opportunity, expecting to do their typical act, but Carmen believes they are really heroes and asks them to rid her village of bad guy El Guapo (Alfonso Arau).

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: Foolish life insurance salesman Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) commits his biggest blunder yet when he unwittingly offers a six-figure policy to notorious gunslinger Jesse James (Wendell Corey). Furious, his boss orders him to repurchase the policy. James, however, parries Farnsworth's attempts with ease, robbing and humiliating him. But when James' latest scheme pairs the patsy with the bandit's sweetheart, Cora Lee Collins (Rhonda Fleming), Farnsworth and Cora begin falling in love.

programme.title: Ned Kelly
programme.desc: In this movie based on a true story, Ned Kelly (Mick Jagger) has served a three-year prison sentence for stealing horses and is released. However, he cannot even begin to get his life in order before his mother (Clarissa Kaye) is arrested and falsely charged with murder. This is the last straw for Ned, who goes on a crime spree with his group, including Joe Byrne (Mark McManus) and Ned's brother, Dan (Allen Bickford). However, eventually the law catches up to them, forcing a fateful showdown.

programme.title: Cannon for Cordoba
programme.desc: During the 1912 Mexican Revolution, rebel leader Hector Córdoba (Raf Vallone) and his bloodthirsty revolutionaries slip across the Texas border and liberate a number of cannons from a U.S. Army fort. Under direct orders from General Pershing (John Russell), Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) heads into Mexican territory to face down Córdoba and get back the American cannons with the help of Mexican military officer Antonio (Gabriele Tinti) and alluring local Leonora (Giovanna Ralli).

programme.title: Cast a Long Shadow
programme.desc: Chip (John Dehner), a ranch foreman, approaches aimless hard-drinker Matt Brown (Audie Murphy) in a New Mexico bar. The owner of Chip's ranch has died and left Matt his land, thinking the troubled drifter may be his long-estranged son. Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). The ranch, however, turns out to be in foreclosure, forcing Matt and Chip to come up with a plan to pay off their debt to the bank.

programme.title: Gun the Man Down
programme.desc: An outlaw is left by his cohorts and girlfriend to be captured after he is wounded during a heist. When he is released from prison, he tracks his old crew to a run-down town and plays a game of cat and mouse with them.

programme.title: Terror in a Texas Town
programme.desc: When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice.

programme.title: Day of the Outlaw
programme.desc: In the quiet frontier town of Bitters, Wyo., a dispute between cattleman Blaise Starrett and farmer Hal Crane is about to boil over into a bloody feud. But the fighting takes a back seat to a new threat when a rogue cavalry captain, Jack Bruhn, rides into town with his band of thugs. Now, with the citizens of Bitters held hostage by Bruhn and his men, Starrett must somehow rescue his town and restore his broken reputation.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: Thanks to his prowess with a gun, Dave Robles (Anthony Quinn) makes a place for himself in Mesa, becoming sheriff after out-dueling several gunfighters in a single day. But Robles, a Mexican, seethes over the town's racism, and is warned by kindly nurse Estella (Katy Jurado) that without his gun, he would not last very long. That theory is put to the test when the new sheriff injures his wrist fighting with Ed Bannister (Peter Whitney), who upon learning about it, challenges Robles to a duel.

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: After a bank robbery goes wrong, outlaw Billy Two Hats (Desi Arnaz Jr.) is captured by Sheriff Gifford (Jack Warden). Billy's partner, Arch Deans (Gregory Peck), rescues him, but during the escape Deans gets shot in the leg. The wound leaves Deans unable to ride a horse, but Billy refuses to leave him behind. Instead, he builds a horse-drawn cot for him, and they continue together. The apparatus slows them down, however, making them even more vulnerable to capture from the pursuing sheriff.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: Retiring to the American West to marry his fiancée, Patricia Terrill (Carroll Baker), Captain James McKay (Gregory Peck) enters a land-and-water feud between his future father-in-law, Major Terrill (Charles Bickford), and the rough and lawless Hannassey family, led by Rufus (Burl Ives). McKay prefers peace between himself and the Hannasseys, who repeatedly attempt to provoke violence. But his steadfast demeanor only angers his fiancé and Major Terrill, who won't settle for truces.

programme.title: Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: Harvard graduate James Averill (Kris Kristofferson) is the sheriff of prosperous Jackson County, Wyo., when a battle erupts between the area's poverty-stricken immigrants and its wealthy cattle farmers. The politically connected ranch owners fight the immigrants with the help of Nathan Champion (Christopher Walken), a mercenary competing with Averill for the love of local madam Ella Watson (Isabelle Huppert). As the struggle escalates, Averill and Champion begin to question their decisions.

programme.title: The Spikes Gang
programme.desc: Will (Gary Grimes), Les (Ron Howard) and Tod (Charlie Martin Smith), teenage farm boys living near the Mexican border, stumble upon Harry Spikes (Lee Marvin), a local bandit near death in the middle of nowhere. After helping bring the aging man back to health, the trio decide to escape their humdrum lives by becoming outlaws themselves. Failing at their first attempt to rob a bank, the boys convince the gruff Spikes to teach them the ways of the desperado.

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: In search of greener pastures, Senator William J. Tadlock (Kirk Douglas) heads west, with scores of settlers following behind. Tadlock has hired an experienced scout, Dick Summers (Robert Mitchum), to accompany the caravan on the way from Missouri to Oregon. But hazards along the trail, and Tadlock's increasing megalomania, threaten to break up the expedition. Their problems get bigger when one of the pilgrims accidentally kills the son of a Sioux chief.

programme.title: Hour of the Gun
programme.desc: While the Earp brothers may have won the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, they didn't escape unscathed for long. Seeking revenge over their fallen comrades, members of the Clanton gang go after the Earp family, gunning down both Virgil and Morgan Earp. But they don't succeed at getting Wyatt (James Garner). Now it's his turn to seek revenge. With Doc Holliday (Jason Robards) by his side, Wyatt forms a posse, and they won't rest until every member of the Clanton gang is dead.

programme.desc: Gunman Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) is an American exiled in Mexico for the revenge killing of his father's assassin. programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: Fleeing the scene of a gruesome gunfight in Mexico, Billy Young (Robert Walker) arrives in the small town of Lordsburg, where he is promptly deputized by local sheriff Ben Kane (Robert Mitchum). Kane takes the troubled young man under his wing, hoping to reform his lawless ways. As the bond between the two men grows stronger, Kane recruits Young for a particularly personal assignment: to help bring to justice Frank Boone (John Anderson), a vicious outlaw responsible for the death of his son.

programme.title: Fort Defiance
programme.desc: After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). After saving Johnny's blind brother, Ned (Peter Graves), from being trampled by a horse, Ben accompanies him to the family ranch. While Ben and Ned become friends, Ned's uncle grows suspicious about Ben's claim of friendship with Johnny. As they all wait for news of Johnny, they face an Indian attack and the arrival of vengeful former soldiers also seeking Johnny.

programme.title: Fort Bowie
programme.desc: A group of Apaches visits a cavalry fort in hopes of laying down their weapons and coming to a peace agreement, but Maj. Wharton (J. Ian Douglas), wanting to make a name for himself, orders his men to massacre them. Meanwhile, Col. Garrett (Kent Taylor) believes his flirtatious wife is sleeping with Capt. Thompson (Ben Johnson), so he tries to get rid of the captain by ordering him to track Victorio (Larry Chance), a notorious Apache warrior who's plotting a large-scale attack on the fort.

programme.title: The Indian Fighter
programme.desc: Johnny Hawks (Kirk Douglas), a Civil War veteran renowned for his prowess in battling Native American tribes, is hired to escort a group of white settlers. But when lowlife Wes Todd (Walter Matthau) discovers that nearby Sioux are hiding a trove of gold, he becomes obsessed with locating it -- which quickly stirs up trouble with local Sioux warriors. However, Hawks, preoccupied with a pretty Sioux woman, Onahti (Elsa Martinelli), doesn't realize that there's conflict until it's too late.

programme.title: The Kentuckian
programme.desc: Upstanding widower "Big Eli" Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) decides to move from Kentucky further west to Texas. He undertakes the journey with just his young son "Little Eli" (Donald MacDonald), but en route they pick up friends like indentured servant Hannah (Dianne Foster) and schoolmarm Susie (Diana Lynn), a potential love interest. This motley crew's path is difficult, and they face many obstacles, not the least of which is nasty frontiersman Stan Bodine (Walter Matthau).

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: Following the American Civil War, veteran Benjamin Trane (Gary Cooper) and gunslinger Joe Erin (Burt Lancaster) are just two of many men who head to Mexico as mercenaries. When Emperor Maximilian (George Macready) recruits their services, they reluctantly work together, since the price is right. Trane and Erin are to escort Countess Marie Duvarre (Denise Darcel) to Veracruz -- but when they find a wealth of gold hidden in the stagecoach, the original plan no longer applies.

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Illiterate fur trapper Joe Bass (Burt Lancaster) is coerced by some Kiowa Indians into trading his haul for a well-educated, escaped slave named Joseph Lee (Ossie Davis). Bass seeks to track the Indians and recover his treasure, while Joseph wants to travel to Mexico, where slavery is illegal. Their plans are complicated by the arrival of a band of scalphunters, led by Jim Howie (Telly Savalas), who want to kill the Indians, claim the furs and resell the black man.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle.

programme.title: Lawman

Bannock's marshal, a righteous man named Jered Maddox (Burt Lancaster), comes to the larger town of Sabbath bearing the dead body of one of the revelers and demands the surrender of the remaining five from sheriff Cotton Ryan (Robert Ryan) and ranch owner Vincent Bronson (Lee J. Cobb), starting a confrontation that threatens to engulf them all.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: Headstrong Thomas Dunson (John Wayne) starts a thriving Texas cattle ranch with the help of his faithful trail hand, Groot (Walter Brennan), and his protégé, Matt Garth (Montgomery Clift), an orphan Dunson took under his wing when Matt was a boy. In need of money following the Civil War, Dunson and Matt lead a cattle drive to Missouri, where they will get a better price than locally, but the crotchety older man and his willful young partner begin to butt heads on the exhausting journey.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: Set during the Civil War, Colonel John Marlowe leads a Union Calvary brigade on a mission behind Confederate lines to destroy enemy railroads and supplies. The colonel is confronted with numerous challenges before reaching Union held Baton Rouge.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: In 1836, the Mexican army, led by General Santa Anna, is invading Texas. Hoping to create a diversion for Santa Anna's forces, General Sam Houston (Richard Boone) orders Colonel William B. Travis (Laurence Harvey), joined by Colonels Jim Bowie (Richard Widmark) and Davy Crockett (John Wayne), to lead a small, heroic band of American and Texican fighters in a resistance battle at the Alamo mission. The carnage at the Alamo further spurs the Republic of Texas toward freedom.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: Inspired by the Battle of the Little Bighorn, this Western follows a selfish military leader, Gen. Frederick McCabe (Andrew Duggan), who unfeelingly throws his soldiers into dangerous battle situations, and the soldiers who must follow his orders. While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger).

programme.title: The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: As the winter of 1867 approaches, Denver inhabitants led by chronic drunk Oracle Jones (Donald Pleasence), who has visions when inebriated, realize with horror that their supply of whiskey will run out before the snows melt. Oracle devises a plan to bring cases of whiskey from a distillery, but is thwarted at every turn. A temperance leader (Lee Remick), three Sioux Indians, and the U.S. Cavalry become interested in the shipment, and a sandstorm and quicksand add to the difficulties.

programme.title: Cattle Annie and Little Britches
programme.desc: Two teenage girls rally what's left of the Doolin-Dalton outlaw gang after Doolin is caught.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programme.desc: By 1885, beloved cavalryman Buffalo Bill Cody (Paul Newman) has hired a publicist and producer to help shape and promote his traveling Wild West show, which presents historically inaccurate reenactments of conflicts between U.S. troops and Native Americans. Cody hires Chief Sitting Bull (Frank Kaquitts) to play himself, as a villain, in stagings of the Battle of the Little Bighorn. But, to Cody's dismay, star performer Annie Oakley (Geraldine Chaplin) and spectators both take to Sitting Bull.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The King and Four Queens
programme.desc: The four McDade brothers stage a successful heist -- except that three of them are killed. When their wives and mother learn that only one of the young men survived with the loot, they are eager to find out which one. Slick traveler Dan Kehoe catches wind of this strange situation and decides to charm the women in hopes of eventually enjoying the spoils. Before long, however, the lonely females begin competing for Dan, disintegrating into a cut-throat battle royal for his heart.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three
programme.desc: Bank robber Graham Dorsey spends a few hours with beautiful widow Amanda Starbuck, in which time his gang takes part in a disastrous holdup. Learning of his comrades' demise, Dorsey goes on the lam. Believing her short-term lover was killed by the law, Amanda decides to make the most of having had a liaison with the supposedly deceased desperado by writing a book about him. Much to his confusion, the still-living Dorsey watches as his name becomes legendary.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Breakheart Pass
programme.desc: When diphtheria breaks out at Fort Humboldt, a train is dispatched with medical supplies and relief troops. Also on board are Utah's governor (Richard Crenna), his mistress (Jill Ireland), a marshal (Ben Johnson) and his prisoner, outlaw John Deakin (Charles Bronson). As the train passes through the mountains, soldiers go missing, telegraph lines are cut and it's discovered that there is no epidemic. There's a conspiracy afoot, and it's up to Deakin, actually a federal agent, to expose it.

programme.title: Chato's Land
programme.desc: Half-Apache Pardon Chato (Charles Bronson) finds himself in a bar fight with a bigoted sheriff and kills the man to save his own life. The locals won't accept this defense, though, and angry Civil War veteran Quincey Whitmore (Jack Palance) rounds up a gang of toughs to track down Chato, who is forced to flee the scene. But when the posse finds Chato's family and brutalizes them, the escapee decides it's time to stop running and start taking revenge on the lynch mob.

programme.title: The White Buffalo
programme.desc: When an aging Wild Bill Hickok (Charles Bronson) finds his dreams invaded by the image of a rampaging white buffalo, he decides the only remedy is to find and kill the creature. With the help of his old friend Charlie (Jack Warden), he sets out across the snowy plains, unaware that he's not the only one looking for the fabled beast. Sioux Chief Crazy Horse (Will Sampson) has recently lost a daughter to the white buffalo, and he fears the girl's soul won't rest until he kills it.

programme.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
programme.desc: Gambler and gunman Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rides into Dodge City, Kan., to visit his straight-arrow brother, Ed (Harry Lauter), who is hoping to defeat crooked sheriff Jim Regan (Don Haggerty) in an upcoming election. Bat purchases and renovates a rundown saloon, attracting the notice of Regan's henchmen. A shooting during the saloon's opening-night celebration causes Bat to pursue his own political vendetta against Regan and attempt to clean up the town's corruption once and for all.

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Five criminals are recruited by the Confederacy for a dangerous mission in exchange for a pardon. The men -- John Morgan Candy (Bob Campbell), William Parcel Candy (Jonathan Haze), J.C. Haggard (Paul Birch), Hale Clinton (Touch Connors) and Govern Sturges (John Lund) -- are to travel to Kansas to intercept a stagecoach carrying Confederate traitor and spy Stephen Jethro (Jack Ingram) and gold. However, when they realize that a woman (Dorothy Malone) is also present, it complicates their mission.

programme.title: Doc
programme.desc: In this take on the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, Doc Holliday (Stacy Keach) travels to Tombstone, Ariz., with prostitute Katie Elder (Faye Dunaway). Although the trip is difficult because Doc is ill with tuberculosis, they eventually reach their destination, where Holliday is reunited with his old friend Marshal Wyatt Earp (Harris Yulin), who has been clashing with the Clanton gang. Tension between Earp and the Clantons rises until their infamous final showdown brings it to a head.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Hour of the Gun
programme.desc: While the Earp brothers may have won the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, they didn't escape unscathed for long. Seeking revenge over their fallen comrades, members of the Clanton gang go after the Earp family, gunning down both Virgil and Morgan Earp. But they don't succeed at getting Wyatt (James Garner). Now it's his turn to seek revenge. With Doc Holliday (Jason Robards) by his side, Wyatt forms a posse, and they won't rest until every member of the Clanton gang is dead.

programme.title: Return of the Seven
programme.desc: The residents of a Mexican village are intimidated by deranged rancher Lorca (Emilio Fernández), who assembles 50 gunmen to force the townspeople to construct a church in honor of his dead sons. Vigilante Chico (Julian Mateos), who previously teamed up with six other sharpshooters to protect the villagers in a time of need, learns of Lorca's harassment and decides to round up the old gang members, including Chris (Yul Brynner) and Vin (Robert Fuller), and ride in to save the town again.

programme.title: Guns of the Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: When Quintero (Fernando Rey), a Mexican revolutionary leader, is left to rot in jail by the forces of President Diaz, it's up to his subordinate, Max (Reni Santoni), to bust him out. After the team is rounded out by experts on close-combat fighting, explosives and knife-throwing, they set off to free Quintero.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: Erstwhile gunslinger Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) has put his rowdy days behind him, settling down with a wife (Mariette Hartley) and serving as the sheriff of his town in the Arizona territory. It's only after De Toro's gang kidnaps Chris's wife that he changes his mind, enlisting a cutthroat gang of prisoners to help him.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: Jake Remy (Warren Oates) and his band of mercenaries shoot their way through a tiny border town, planning to escape with their plunder across the river into Mexico. By the time Jake reaches the river, Travis has already taken everyone from the town to the Mexican side. He refuses passage to the mercenaries, and a lengthy standoff ensues.

programme.title: The Missouri Breaks

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman) is a rich cattle rancher. He has a bad relationship with his wife, Melissa (Candice Bergen), whom he treats like a possession. While Brandt is away from home on a hunting trip, Frank Calder (Oliver Reed), a brazen outlaw, kidnaps Melissa and holds her for ransom. Frank, however, treats Melissa better than her own husband does, and before long she begins to develop feelings for him. When Brandt returns, he's enraged and vows to take violent revenge against Frank.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

Later, the ladies welcome various celebrities, who join them in a chat or perform for the audience. The program also offers tips on beauty, fashion, diet and relationships. programme.title: Jimmy Kimmel Live!
programme.desc: Emmy-winning funnyman Jimmy Kimmel serves up comedy bits and welcomes guests that include other comics, celebrities, athletes and musicians, as well as everyday people with unusual or compelling personal stories. Kimmel's family and friends take part in the festivities, including his Cousin Sal, Uncle Frank (until his death in 2011) and childhood friend Cleto Escobedo III, who leads the show's house band. Recurring segments include the FCC-pleasing This Week in Unnecessary Censorship in which they take TV clips and "bleep and blur things whether they need it or not," as Kimmel describes it. But it's too bad they consistently run out of time for Matt Damon's segment.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.title: Greatest American Hero
programme.desc: While on a road trip through a desert, mild-mannered high-school teacher Ralph Hinkley (temporarily changed to Ralph Hanley for part of season one due to real-life current events) is greeted by extraterrestrials, who present him with an extraordinary red flying suit that imbues him with uncanny powers. Learning of the suit, high-strung FBI agent Bill Maxwell convinces Ralph to help him fight crime. Ralph's girlfriend, attorney Pam Davidson, also knows of his secret life as a superhero.

programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: Tornado Range
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his partner, Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), escort homesteaders into Texas to settle. Determined to resist the settlement, rancher Lance King (George Chesebro) organizes the locals, despite both the caution of his daughter, Mary (Jennifer Holt), and a government document delivered by Eddie assuring the homesteaders of their rights. As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives.

programme.title: Panhandle

When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: Ambush Trail
programme.desc: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Range Beyond the Blue
programme.desc: A stagecoach operator in the untamed territories of the American Southwest, Margie Rodgers (Helen Mowery) becomes a target for bandits when she starts hauling gold. Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation.

programme.title: Border Feud
programme.desc: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: Frontier Fugitives
programme.desc: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: Man From Oklahoma
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Twilight in the Sierras
programme.desc: Parole officer Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) visits his kindhearted friend Judge Wiggins (Edward Keane) at his home for rehabilitated ex-convicts. Behind the judge's back, foreman Matt Brunner (George Meeker) has been running a counterfeiting ring with the unwilling help of former prisoner Ricardo Chavez (Russ Vincent). An accident during a lion hunt causes Deputy Sheriff Pat Callahan (Dale Evans) to arrest Roy for murder, while Brunner's henchmen kidnap Chavez's visiting sister (Estelita Rodriguez).

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

programme.title: Sweet Dreams
programme.desc: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes.

programme.title: A Streetcar Named Desire
programme.desc: Based on the play by Tennessee Williams, this renowned drama follows troubled former schoolteacher Blanche DuBois (Vivien Leigh) as she leaves small-town Mississippi and moves in with her sister, Stella Kowalski (Kim Hunter), and her husband, Stanley (Marlon Brando), in New Orleans. Blanche's flirtatious Southern-belle presence causes problems for Stella and Stanley, who already have a volatile relationship, leading to even greater conflict in the Kowalski household.

programme.title: A History of Violence
programme.desc: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. programme.title: America's Black Forum
programme.desc: Political analyst Marc Morial hosts a weekly syndicated newsmagazine series featuring in-depth and engaging interviews with newsmakers, influencers, business entrepreneurs, artists, health and wellness experts and social justice leaders. Targeted to an African American audience, "America's Black Forum" was an hourlong production from 1977 to 2006. It has been revived as a 30-minute series after being off the air for 15 years, but has maintained the same format.

programme.title: Awesome Science
programme.desc: In this episode, Noah travels to the Southwest to explore Yosemite National Park and Zion National Park. He’ll discover amazing evidence for the quick formation of the granite rocks at Yosemite during the Flood, the massive erosion of the granite, and also the quick accumulation of ice in the valleys from ideal conditions right after the Flood. At Zion Noah will explore evidence of how the massive sandstone layers were made during the Flood, then eroded during the sheet and channel erosion as the flood waters receded.

programme.title: Awesome Science
programme.desc: In this episode, Noah travels to one of the few active volcanoes in the contiguous United States to find out why it’s called, “God’s gift to creationists.” Through cataclysmic events back in the 1980s, similar geologic features worldwide can now be explained by the Flood using Mount St. Helens as a scale model. Noah explores each of these features at the mountain, including a huge lava cave and lava cast forests. The features found here can help us understand catastrophic processes that were thought by secular scientists to take millions of years taking only hours or days.

programme.title: 3ABN Hoy
programme.sub-title: Testimonio personal del Pr. José Feliciano Castillo Lugo
programme.desc: En esta inspiradora entrevista, el Pastor José Feliciano Castillo Lugo comparte profundamente su testimonio personal. Inicia relatando su infancia en Castaños, Coahuila (México), marcada por el alcoholismo de su padre. Sin embargo, tras “un último trago”, su padre decidió darle una oportunidad a Cristo. Este paso lo llevó a la Iglesia Adventista del Séptimo Día local, donde se bautizó y experimentó una transformación total, convirtiéndose en un ejemplo de rectitud para su familia. El Pr. Castillo continúa narrando su etapa como universitario, un periodo lleno de adversidades, frustraciones y desafíos. A pesar de ello, afirma que Dios lo sostuvo y lo ayudó a superar cada obstáculo. En ese proceso, Dios le mostró los “caminos torcidos” en los que viví a, y él tomó la decisión de enderezar sus pasos para honrar a Dios. Esta experiencia de cambio lo llevó finalmente al ministerio. Después de servir como oficial en México, hoy es evangelista y pastor en el estado de Tennessee, donde continúa compartiendo el mensaje de esperanza. Está casado con KeSardis, quien lo acompaña en el ministerio, y juntos crían a sus tres hijas. La entrevista es un testimonio poderoso de cómo Dios transforma vidas y abre nuevos comienzos. Para más historias de transformación y una amplia programación cristiana, puede descargar gratuitamente la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscribirse al canal 3ABN Latino en YouTube.

Flash is looking for clues to the fate of his father, the eminent scientist Dr. Lawrence Gordon, previously believed to have died in a laboratory fire several years earlier. His quest, however, leads him into the clutches of Ming, the evil ruler of Mongo, and his devious daughter, Aura. Flash escapes back to Earth, vowing to foil the ruthless Ming's threat to humanity. Fortunately, in addition to Dale, Flash can count on help from Baylin, a beautiful but tough intergalactic bounty hunter, and Hans Zarkov, the eccentric former associate of Flash's father.
