programme.desc: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
programme.desc: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
programme.desc: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

programme.title: Worth the Hype
programme.sub-title: Chiles, Burgers, & Tenderloins in Santa Fe
programme.desc: Frankie heads to Santa Fe investigating New Mexican cuisines eating green chile burgers, poblano chile stews, and sweet blue-corn pancakes.

programme.title: Worth the Hype
programme.desc: Frankie explores Hawaii's O'ahu island to get nourished from fresh tuna poke, heartfelt Pho, and hand-pounded poi.

programme.title: Worth the Hype
programme.sub-title: Quail, Alligator Sausage, & Gumbo in New Orleans
programme.desc: Frankie stops by New Orleans to chow down on lacquered quail, a beast of a Po Boy, and Creole Beef Daube.

programme.title: Worth the Hype
programme.sub-title: Cubanos, Empanadas, & Smoked Beef Rib in Miami
programme.desc: Frankie goes to Miami to sample serious cherry smoked beef rib, three cheese spinach empanadas, and a legendary Cubano sandwich with homemade mustard.

programme.title: Worth the Hype
programme.sub-title: Smash Burgers & A Slice in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza heads to all the buzzworthy spots in LA - cooking up calamari steak at a classic Mexican joint, tasting taro root donuts with fun flavors, grabbing a guanciale slice, and hopping on the line to make cheesy scrumptious smash burgers.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Exploring the town of Tequila, Jalisco; the history of making tequila and a close up look at the process from the agave fields to the tasting table.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Roasted tomatoes rice with cumin and oregano; chicken livers with chipotle caramelized onions; avocado and panela cheese salad.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: A Mayan League of Their Own
programme.desc: Amazonas softball team; sweet potato and meat salpicon; pepita, egg and chaya tamales; roasted tomato and habanero salsa.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's India
programme.desc: Luke learns about Kongunadu cuisine in Coimbatore, partners with a family in Thrissur to create an authentic delicacy and learns about India's rich coffee culture.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's India
programme.desc: Luke visits the port city of Kochi, Kerala, where he checks out the iconic Chinese fishing nets, does laundry the old-fashioned way and cooks a famous dish. He leaves the city to witness the state's backwaters and local fishing techniques.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's India
programme.sub-title: Hunting for Ancient Spices in Thekkady
programme.desc: Luke visits the lush plantations of spices in Thekkady and then tours Madurai, the spiritual heart of Tamil Nadu, to find hidden gems with the help of a local food journalist.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's India
programme.sub-title: The Outrageous Street Food of Pondicherry
programme.desc: Luke uncovers the history of Chettinad and savours its famous cuisine. He then tastes the chutneys in Kumbakonam and explores the exciting food scene in Pondicherry.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's India
programme.sub-title: The Outrageous Street Food of Pondicherry
programme.desc: Luke uncovers the history of Chettinad and savours its famous cuisine. He then tastes the chutneys in Kumbakonam and explores the exciting food scene in Pondicherry.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati spends a day in Sonora's capital, Hermosillo, visiting some of the city's best culinary destinations. From gigantic burritos at Doña Guille to Sonoran hot dogs, Pati experiences all Hermosillo's food scene has to offer.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: On the coast in Bahía Kino, local fishermen catch giant sea scallops. Then, in the mountain town of Matape, Nere, one of Sonora's few female butchers shares her wisdom with Pati.

programme.title: The Overcomers
programme.desc: In this series you will hear some amazing testimonies of individuals whose lives have been transformed by the Lord.

programme.title: The Mystery Revealed - Eric Wilson
programme.desc: Many Christians today, even in our own churches, are struggling with doubt, sin, and a longing to be free. But God has promised freedom through His Son, Jesus. Join us as we study God’s Word together and learn how to believe for true salvation, freedom, healing, and restoration by claiming His promises through faith.

programme.title: Take Charge of Your Health
programme.desc: Take Charge of Your Health is a wellness-focused series featuring interviews with medical experts, Bible study of wellness principles, and practical instruction in lifestyle change for health improvement.

programme.title: Heart Wise Ministries - The Heart of Health
programme.desc: The Heart of Health is a call in health program providing viewers with an opportunity to call in and get free medical advice from guests who practice medicine every day.

programme.title: It Is Written Canada
programme.sub-title: The Church That Would Not Burn
programme.desc: Mike and René Lemon are the hosts for It Is Written Canada, a nationwide television ministry that spotlights the life-transforming power of trusting God’s Word.

programme.title: Unsealed Insights
programme.desc: Secrets Unsealed Ministry quarterly update program takes a look at how God has been moving through the ministry. Featuring updates from our pastoral department, testimonies from the field, new media projects, and upcoming initiatives — all designed to inform, inspire, and invite you to become part of the mission.

programme.title: Watch and Pray at Midnight
programme.desc: Are we living in the "Midnight Hour" referenced in the parable of Matthew 24 and 25? Looking at events taking place around us we can see the approaching crisis. This series will cover different crises affecting the world and what it can teach us about God and our need for a refinement.

programme.title: SUMtv Stories
programme.desc: SUMtv sits down with church members and ministry leaders as they share their testimonies of hope, redemption, and spiritual growth.

programme.title: Three Angels Made Practical
programme.desc: We may have the theological understanding of the Three Angels Messages but do we understand how to make these messages practical and relevant to our lives? In this ten-part series Lo-ammi Richardson will go text-by-text to help break down the commands to fear God, give glory, and worship Him.

programme.title: Last Generation Theology
programme.sub-title: The Cleansing of the Two Temples
programme.desc: What is Last Generation Theology? Very likely you've heard this phrase in the church during the past few years. Is it an anti-gospel, legalistic heresy, as some have alleged? Or is it the Bible-based rationale for the existence, message, and mission of the Seventh-day Adventist movement? The purpose of this symposium is to take these questions to the Bible and the writings of the Spirit of Prophecy to discover God's answers.

programme.title: Matthew 24
programme.desc: Among all the prophecies of the Bible, Matthew 24 is unique because it presents end time events in the precise order in which they will occur. Thus, Matthew 24 serves as a blueprint for the study of Bible prophecy. This chapter (along with the parallel chapters in Mark 13 and Luke 21) describes events such as the little time of trouble, the latter rain, the loud cry, the universal Sunday law, the great tribulation, Satan’s counterfeit second coming, the sign of the Son of Man and the gathering of the elect. Don’t miss out on this important series.

programme.title: The Best of I'd Like to Know
programme.desc: The Best of I'd Like to Know revisits some of the series’ most compelling questions about the Bible, faith, and Christian life. Through Scripture-based answers and thoughtful discussion, these selected episodes invite you to discover timeless biblical truths, and deepen your understanding of God’s Word.

programme.title: Living Well
programme.desc: "So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God." (1 Corinthians 10:31) How can we use food to glorify God? When we honor our bodies by fueling them with the natural God-given foods presented in the Bible, we feel capable to carry out the mission God has for our lives. This series, featuring many educated hosts, presents step-by-step demonstrations for delicious vegetarian/vegan recipes that will help you enjoy your food and live well!

programme.title: Timeless Healing Insights - Revelation
programme.sub-title: Avoiding The Mark of the Beast - Part 1
programme.desc: Disaster/emergency preparedness is one key to surviving and thriving in the midst of difficulties. God has shed light on the "Mark of the Beast" to bless His people.

programme.title: Amazing Facts with Doug Bachelor
programme.sub-title: The Woman in the Wilderness Part 1/2

programme.title: God's Principles for Healthy Relationships - Season 2
programme.sub-title: Warning! Don't Miss These Red Flags
programme.desc: Whether you're navigating the complexities of creating relationships or seeking to deepen or mend your current relationships, this series provides invaluable wisdom for a true love and healing that lasts. Drawing from biblical principles and practical strategies, certified Life and Relationship coaches Martin and Debbie Raj share their journey, promoting forgiveness, values, self-worth and joy in Jesus. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
programme.desc: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

programme.title: Bustin' Loose
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Richard Pryor) takes handicapped orphans and their teacher (Cicely Tyson) from Philadelphia to Washington state by bus.","large":"Parole officer Donald (Robert Christian) compels his foul-mouthed ex-con charge Joe Braxton (Richard Pryor) to escort a bus full of special education students from Philadelphia to the Pacific Northwest, where their teacher Vivian Perry (Cicely Tyson) plans to set up a new school. But when Braxton's latest attempt at going straight becomes a frustrating series of mishaps, he struggles to complete the job he was hired to do while resisting his growing affection for Vivian and the children.

programme.title: Born in East L.A.
programme.desc: A Los Angeles native (Cheech Marin) is rounded up by mistake with illegal aliens and dumped south of the border.

programme.title: Slap Shot
programme.desc: A minor-league hockey team makes sports history when its members decide to spruce up the team's image by playing dirty.","large":"In the small New England town of Charlestown, the local mill is about to lay off 10,000 workers. The town's minor league hockey team, the Charlestown Chiefs, is doing no better. After years of failure, this will be the team's last season. Exasperated player and coach Reggie Dunlop (Paul Newman) lets the club's recent acquisitions, the Hanson Brothers, play. The brothers' actively violent and thuggish style of play excites the fans. Dunlop retools the team, using violence to draw big crowds.

programme.title: For Love of the Game
programme.desc: An aging pitcher (Kevin Costner) learns that he will soon lose his girlfriend (Kelly Preston) and his spot with the Detroit Tigers.","large":"Forty-year-old pitcher Billy Chapel (Kevin Costner) is practically a dinosaur by professional baseball standards, fast approaching the end of his career. But, as Chapel stands on the mound pitching the game of his life, his thoughts don't turn to his prized history in sports, but rather return again and again to his tumultuous relationship with Jane Aubrey (Kelly Preston), a single mom who has stood at his side through the good and the bad but is now on the verge of leaving him.

programme.title: The Babe
programme.desc: Abandoned as a boy, George Herman Ruth (John Goodman) grows up to be a larger-than-life baseball hero.","large":"George Herman "Babe" Ruth (John Goodman) grows from a troubled boy who was sent to an orphanage to one of the most successful baseball players on record. Babe first becomes a power hitter and pitcher for the Boston Red Sox. After a falling-out with Red Sox owner Harry Frazee (Peter Donat), Babe is sold to the New York Yankees. He is idolized in New York, setting a record for home runs, as well as creating dramatic moments like hitting two homers for a sick boy in the hospital.

programme.title: The Best of Times
programme.desc: Two men (Robin Williams, Kurt Russell) get to replay a high-school football game 16 years after one dropped the other's touchdown pass.","large":"Married banker Jack Dundee (Robin Williams) has lived his life regretting a botched play he made in a high school football game. His friend Reno Hightower (Kurt Russell), who threw the pass that Jack dropped, is deeply in debt from operating his car garage. With Reno, Jack hatches a plan to reunite all the players from the old game and replay it, hoping that this time he can make amends. When the game eventually happens, Jack again finds himself at the center of a key play.

Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. As the possessed battle the survivors, student Kelly (Susan Blanchard) is infected by a large quantity of the liquid and becomes Satan personified.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Because of a time warp, a supermarket worker finds himself fighting in medieval England with a chainsaw and a '73 Oldsmobile.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: A mercenary leader (Simon Baker) squares off with a rebellious comrade (John Leguizamo), while flesh-eating zombies threaten their fortified city.","large":"In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Darkman II: The Return of Durant
programme.desc: Crime lord Robert G. Durant (Larry Drake) awakens from a coma and again destroys disfigured Darkman's (Arnold Vosloo) liquid-skin laboratory.","large":"Scientist Peyton Westlake (Arnold Vosloo) returns to his lab believing he has disposed of his nemesis, mobster Robert G. While Darkman is perfecting an artificial skin that will restore his old appearance, Durant inexplicably returns to torment him. Overcome by rage, Darkman disguises himself with the artificial skin, setting out to infiltrate Durant's world and bring him to justice.

programme.title: Frenzy
programme.desc: Circumstantial evidence holds an innocent Londoner (Jon Finch) for the work of a rapist who strangles his victims with neckties.","large":"London is held in the grip of a serial killer whose modus operandi is to murder his victims by strangling them with a necktie. Forced to go on the run, Blaney attempts to take refuge with his best friend, fruit merchant Bob Rusk (Barry Foster) ; however, Rusk may, in fact, be the necktie murderer himself.

programme.title: Streets of Fire

In an attempt to save his star act, Ellen's manager, Billy Fish (Rick Moranis), hires Tom to rescue Ellen. Billy and Tom, along with former soldier McCoy (Amy Madigan), battle through dangerous cityscapes, determined to get Ellen back.

programme.title: Sneakers
programme.desc: An ex-'60s-radical computer hacker (Robert Redford) and his company are tapped for a shady black-box job.","large":"Computer hacker Martin (Robert Redford) heads a group of specialists who test the security of various San Francisco companies. When Martin realizes the NSA men who approached him are rogue agents, they frame him for the murder of the device's inventor.

programme.desc: A Western deputy sheriff (James Brolin) chases a driverless black car that keeps running people down.","large":"Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: A trucker with a vehicular manslaughter conviction agrees to drive a suspicious shipment for his boss.","large":"An ex-con takes a job truck driving across the country. programme.title: The Jackal
programme.desc: A jailed IRA operative (Richard Gere) helps the FBI track a masterful assassin (Bruce Willis) about to perform a political killing.","large":"During an FBI raid on a Moscow nightclub, the brother of Russian gangster Terek Murad (David Hayman) is killed. Murad wants revenge and hires anonymous hit man the Jackal (Bruce Willis) to kill FBI Deputy Director Carter Preston (Sidney Poitier). With the help of Russian agent Valentina Koslova (Diane Venora), Preston finds the only man who knows what the notorious Jackal looks like, imprisoned IRA terrorist Declan Mulqueen (Richard Gere), and forces him to help hunt down the hit man.

programme.title: Mercury Rising
programme.desc: An FBI renegade (Bruce Willis) tries to stop his nemesis (Alec Baldwin) from killing an autistic boy (Miko Hughes) who cracked a government code.","large":""Mercury Rising" stars Bruce Willis as Art Jeffries, a renegade FBI agent who combats ruthless federal agents to protect Simon (Miko Hughes), a 9-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new unbreakable code. He can read MERCURY, the most advanced encryption code yet created, as easily as other kids read English. This ability renders the new billion-dollar secret code vulnerable, especially if enemies of the United States should learn of Simon's abilities and capture him.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: An ex-cop (Arnold Schwarzenegger) must protect a woman chosen by Satan (Gabriel Byrne) to be the mother of the Antichrist.","large":"With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes a couple (Kevin Bacon, Radha Mitchell) and their two children after the young son brings home some mysterious rocks from the Grand Canyon.","large":"Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.desc: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

programme.desc: An architect (Michael Keaton) believes his dead wife (Chandra West) is using electronic devices to communicate with him.","large":"Architect Jonathan Rivers (Michael Keaton) is happily married to author Anna (Chandra West), but tragedy strikes when she is killed in an accident. Jonathan eventually comes to believe Raymond's claims, but, as he is drawn further into investigating the phenomenon, a sinister supernatural presence invades his life.

programme.desc: After nearly being killed along with his family, a man recovers and realizes that he can sense when someone is about to die.","large":"A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: As a woman (Jessica Chastain) tries to reintroduce her lover's (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) traumatized nieces to a normal life, disturbing questions and occurrences suggest that a supernatural presence has followed the girls to her home.","large":"On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night.

programme.desc: With the help of a spiritualist (Gary Oldman), a woman (Odette Yustman) uncovers a family curse dating back to Nazi Germany and involving a demonic spirit with the power to inhabit anything or anyone.","large":"Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, a man (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their haunted hometown and uncovers a supernatural link to her death.","large":"After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: A teenager (Shelley Hennig) and her five friends (Moses Storm, Renee Olstead) become the prey of an unknown online presence that wants revenge for a shaming video that caused a classmate to kill herself one year prior.","large":"One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." programme.title: Libera

programme.title: Mina Settembre

programme.desc: Wie steht es um die Barrierefreiheit in New York City, einer der größten Städte der Welt? James Rath stürzt sich in ein Abenteuer im Big Apple, um herauszufinden, ob er sich dort als Blinder durchschlagen kann.

programme.title: Abenteuer Israel - Zu Fuß durch ein begehrtes Land
programme.desc: Die Reportage begleitet zwei junge Deutsche, Kim und Eike, bei ihrer Wanderung durch Israel. Sie sprechen mit jungen Israelis darüber, was es heute für sie bedeutet, jüdisch zu sein. Der letzte Teil der Reise führt die beiden durch die Wüste Negev.

programme.title: Ein Mammut-Projekt - Wiedergeburt ausgestorbener Arten
programme.desc: Weltweit arbeiten Forscher daran, verschwundene Tierarten neu zu erschaffen. Mammut und Beutelwolf sollen zurückkehren. Mit modernen Bio- und Gentechniken gewinnen sie aus Museumsexponaten Baupläne ihres verloren geglaubten Erbguts.

programme.title: Libellen: Funkelnde Jäger
programme.desc: Libellen schillern wie Schmetterlinge, jagen unter wie über der Wasseroberfläche und sind Flugkünstler, von denen sich selbst Kolibris etwas abschauen könnten. Sie existierten lange vor den Dinosauriern. Es wird ihrem Erfolgsgeheimnis nachgegangen.

programme.title: Abenteuer Deutschland
programme.desc: Die Sendung schaut auf die idyllische Natur in Deutschland und zeigt dafür die schönsten Seen und Flüsse des Landes. Außerdem schaut sie auf die uralten Wälder und seine verschiedene Bewohner wie Wildschweine, Luchse und Wölfe.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Im Herbst ereignet sich im nördlichen Pazifik ein Naturschauspiel. Tausende Lachse kehren in die Laichgebiete des Katmai-Nationalparks zurück. Braunbären nutzen die Migration aus und schlagen sich vor dem Winterschlaf den Bauch voll.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Casey Anderson folgt Bärenfamilien, die während der Lachsmigration fischen gehen. Tausende Lachse kehren in ihre Laichgebiete zurück und die Bären haben viele verschiedene Techniken entwickelt, um an die begehrten Fische zu gelangen.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Im Herbst wandern Tausende von Lachsen aus dem nördlichen Pazifik zurück zum Katmai-Nationalpark. Die große Population der Braunbären schlägt sich dann die Bäuche mit Fisch voll, um sich auf den Winterschlaf vorzubereiten.

programme.title: Ein Leben unter Affen
programme.desc: Es ist eine einzigartige Langzeitbeobachtung des Biologen Wolfgang Dittus, der seit 50 Jahren die Hutaffen in der alten Tempelstadt Polonnaruwa in Sri Lanka studiert. Er präsentiert faszinierende Einblicke in ihr Gesellschaftsleben.

programme.title: Wilde Insel Borneo
programme.desc: In dieser Dokumentation geht es um die außergewöhnliche Artenvielfalt auf Borneo. Dabei zählen unter anderem Orang-Utans bis hin zu Malaienbären zu den beheimateten Tierarten, die das tropische Inselreich für sich beanspruchen.

programme.title: Die Leoparden von Yala
programme.desc: In dem Yala-Nationalpark kommt es in der großen Leoparden-Population zu Rangeleien. Die männlichen Leoparden wollen ihr Territorium beschützen und kämpfen um Paarungsrechte, während die Weibchen das Überleben ihrer Jungen sichern wollen.

programme.title: Unter Löwen
programme.desc: Im afrikanischen Tansania prallen die Welt der Löwen und die der Menschen aufeinander. Während der Trockenzeit in der Nähe der Serengeti bedrohen hungrige Löwen die Existenz des Viehzüchters Rugari und die seiner Familie.

programme.title: Strandwolf
programme.desc: Die deutsche Wissenschaftlerin Ingrid Wiesel widmet ihr Leben der Erforschung der scheuen Schabrackenhyäne. An den kargen Küsten Afrikas kämpft sie für das Überleben dieser seltenen Raubtiere und liefert faszinierende Einblicke in deren Alltag.

programme.title: Geheimnisse des Yellowstone
programme.desc: Im US-Bundesstaat Montana liegt in den Sedimentablagerungen eine der reichsten Ansammlungen an Fossilien aus der Kreidezeit. Hier wurden berühmte Dinosaurier entdeckt, nun auch der vollständig erhaltene Schädel eines Triceratops.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Der Karpfen könnte zum neuen Trendfisch werden. Er hat die wohl niedrigste CO2-Bilanz aller Speisefische, kommt ohne Fischmehl und Antibiotika aus und gedeiht in heimischen Gewässern. Allerdings gilt der Karpfen als schlammig und voller Gräten.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Neue Fische fürs Mittelmeer - Aufzucht als letzte Rettung
programme.desc: Die Fischbestände im Mittelmeer sind drastisch zurückgegangen. In Marseille soll ein "Fisch-Kindergarten" dazu beitragen, dass sich auch selten gewordene Meerestiere geschützt entwickeln können und sich die Bestände wieder erholen.

programme.title: Suppressed Science - Geheimnisse der Wissenschaft

programme.title: Suppressed Science - Geheimnisse der Wissenschaft

programme.title: Suppressed Science - Geheimnisse der Wissenschaft
programme.desc: Die Sendung befasst sich mit der Frage, ob es möglich ist, das Klima mit technischen Mitteln zu kontrollieren. Bisher haben die Eingriffe der Menschen die Erde an den Rand einer Klimakrise gebracht, aus der es keinen Ausweg zu geben scheint.

programme.desc: Windkraftanlagen erzeugen weltweit inzwischen mehr als 700 Gigawatt Strom, genug, um fast 500 Millionen Haushalte zu versorgen. Eine Schlüsselrolle kommt künftig leistungsstarken Offshore-Windparks wie East Anglia One vor der britischen Küste zu.

programme.desc: Windkraftanlagen erzeugen weltweit inzwischen mehr als 700 Gigawatt Strom, genug, um fast 500 Millionen Haushalte zu versorgen. Eine Schlüsselrolle kommt künftig leistungsstarken Offshore-Windparks wie East Anglia One vor der britischen Küste zu.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Die Suche nach einer neuen, vor allem nachhaltigen Energiequelle ist die bislang größte technische Herausforderung. Forscher arbeiten seit Jahren an der Entwicklung eines Fusionsreaktors, der endlos Energie liefern soll, bislang vergebens.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Einen Flug ohne fossile Brennstoffe erleben ist das Ziel. Obwohl Elektroautos längst die Städte erobert haben, gelten Flugzeuge mit Elektroantrieb als visionär. Das Start-up "Heart Aerospace" verspricht eine nachhaltige Lösung für die Luftfahrt.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Die Sendung zeigt Versandunternehmen, die daran arbeiten, ihre Branche umweltfreundlicher zu machen.

programme.title: Die Klimaretter
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation begleitet die Klimaaktivisten bei ihren vielfältigen Protestaktionen. Zu den Feindbildern der Demonstranten gehört der SUV, der als CO2-Schleuder oder Klimakiller verrufen ist, und die schwimmenden Bettenburgen der Dampfschifffahrt.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Andreas Fath ist Chemieprofessor sowie Hobbyschwimmer und will die Donau durchschwimmen - vom Schwarzwald bis zum Schwarzen Meer, 2.700 km flussabwärts. Die Aktion soll auf die Gefahren von Mikroplastik aufmerksam machen.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Der Trans-Sulawesi Highway ist die Lebensader der viertgrößten Insel Indonesiens und verbindet verschiedene Orte. Traumhafte Strände, turbulente Großstädte oder tiefe Urwälder. Als Busfahrer auf dem Highway braucht man Know-how und starke Nerven.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Im äußersten Nordosten Norwegens, der Finnmark, sind die Winter eiskalt und schneereich. Durch die Lage am Arktischen Ozean sind die Straßen anfällig für Schneeverwehungen. Jeder Meter ist eine Herausforderung und eine Fahrt ins Risiko.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Im Off-Road Park gelten andere Regeln als im Straßenverkehr. Die Sendung ist geeignet für Menschen, die schon als Kind vom Bagger fahren träumten. Auf einem riesigen Spielplatz werden Tatra-LKWs, Quads und Offroad-Trainer bewegt.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Die Vorstellung, vom Gleitschirm aus die atemberaubende Aussicht auf die Erde zu genießen, fasziniert viele. Fluglehrer Lukas Bader bringt seinen Schülern genau das bei, indem er sie in der notwendigen Theorie für einen Flugschein unterrichtet.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh Yozura begibt sich diesmal nach Zypern. Von Nikosia aus reist er quer durch das Land zu einem verlassenen Vergnügungspark. Außerdem besucht er ein ehemaliges Asbestbergwerk und ein Schiffswrack, das sich vor der Küste befindet.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local

programme.desc: Vier Wochen hat Deutschland Fußball geschaut. Währenddessen hat die Berliner Polizei ohne Ende Überstunden gemacht. Denn Millionen Fans aus aller Herren Ländern im Griff zu haben, ist wie ein Sack euphorisierte und betrunkene Flöhe zu hüten.

programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse bekommt ein Oldie-VW-Bus aus Arizona eine Frischzellenkur, während bei Lundtauto in Berlin ein Porsche 911 aus den 1970er-Jahren auf eine Komplettrestaurierung wartet. In Hamburg kommen nur britische Originale auf die Hebebühne.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die Schrauber der Minis Hamburg lassen die Flex kreisen, um Rost von Minis zu entfernen. Porsche-Spezialist Thomas Lundt hat sich der anspruchsvollen Restaurierung von Oldtimern verschrieben, während in Hamburg eine Vespa aufgebaut wird.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse bekommt der T1-Oldie neue Safari-Fenster, während bei den Roller-Profis der Flying Classics heute eine Ausfahrt ansteht. Motor-Spezialist Michi von den Minis Hamburg setzt bei der Getriebereparatur nicht nur auf seine Erfahrung.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die frisch lackierte Porsche-Karosse wartet bei Lundt in Berlin auf das Motorfinish, während Manni von den Minis Hamburg eine durchgerostete Tür wieder auf Vordermann bringt. In der Roller-Werkstatt der Flying Classics ist Abschied angesagt.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James und sein älterer Bruder Colton fahren nach Austin, Texas, um BBQ von einem blinden Grillmeister und Live-Musik von einem blinden Musiker zu genießen. Ein kurzer Roadtrip nach Houston bringt sie mit der blinden Starköchin Christine Ha zusammen.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Die Reisereportage begleitet blinde Menschen auf ihren Abenteuern. In der siebten Folge der ersten Staffel werden die Sinne der Protagonisten an ungewöhnlichen Orten gefordert, während sie kulturelle sowie landschaftliche Highlights erleben.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Der blinde Regisseur James Rath bereist Metropolen, um zu zeigen, dass dies auch für eingeschränkte Personen möglich ist - wenn es mit der Barrierefreiheit ernst genommen wird. Er und Cassie besuchen diesmal die "ETH Zürich".

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: In Tokio versucht James, sich nicht in der Menge zu verlieren. Er will zudem seine Angst vor Meeresfrüchten überwinden. Er trifft einen blinden Breakdancer und erfährt, wie Sehende und Blinde sich auf die nächste Naturkatastrophe vorbereiten.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Der Hochgeschwindigkeitszug bringt James nach Osaka und seinem Ziel näher: dem Aufstieg auf den Fuji. Abseits großer Städte sucht James in den Tempeln von Kyoto nach Frieden. Heilige Traditionen bieten ihm eine neue Perspektive auf das Leben.

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Den Neusser Krieg von 1475 inszenieren hunderte europäische Spätmittelalter-Rollenspieler wieder. In der Stadt Zons am Rhein stehen kostümierte Männer mit Schwertern und Lanzen, um diese historische Schlacht wieder auf zu erleben.

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Die Frightguys sind Fans von Grauen und Grusel - oder kurz dem Horror-Genre. Sie leben mit ihren selbst gemachten Kostümen auf Conventions und Szene-Treffen ihre schönsten Albträume aus, um in die Rollen ihrer schauderhaften Figuren zu schlüpfen.

programme.title: Buddhas Kämpfer
programme.desc: In einem Wald bei Kaiserslautern liegt das einzige Shaolin-Kloster Europas, das Kampfmönche ausbildet. Novizen und Meister trainieren hier bis zu acht Stunden täglich. Ziel sind körperliche Grenzerfahrungen und die Befreiung des Geistes.

programme.title: Schicksalstor Europa
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation zeigt den Flüchtlingsstrom nach Europa mit seinen Hunderttausenden an Migranten, die im Jahr illegal in die EU zu gelangen versuchen. Ob Balkanroute, Mittelmeer oder Ärmelkanal, viele der Flüchtlinge setzen ihr Leben aufs Spiel.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment
programme.sub-title: Interstate: How the Interstate Connected and Divided America
programme.desc: Dwight Eisenhower's interstate highway system was the biggest infrastructure project of its time, a bold plan to connect all corners of America and boost the post-war economy, but it also ended up deepening the divide between rich and poor.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment
programme.desc: Edison pioneered the world's first research and development center in Menlo Park and worked with a group of experimenters to methodically zero in on the holy grail of electric light.

programme.title: The Tulip Bubble
programme.desc: The burst of the enormous tulip bubble in 1637 Netherlands serves as reminder of how quickly financial holdings and futures can rise or drop.

programme.sub-title: Like Button: The Unintended Consenquences of the Facebook Like Button
programme.desc: When first presented with the like button Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg worried that a quick thumbs up or down would discourage more meaningful online interaction but eventually his team changed his mind and transformed the world.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment
programme.sub-title: Cubicle: How the Cubicle Became Universally Hated
programme.desc: The Cubicle was originally designed to set workers free; a futuristic designer named Robert Propst dreamed up the cubicle as a groovy 1960s workplace utopia that would unleash the modern knowledge worker's vast untapped potential.

programme.sub-title: Barcode: How the Barcode Shaped Our Modern Economy

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Christophe Rocancourt is a French impostor and con artist who scammed rich and powerful people by masquerading in turn as a French nobleman, the heir to the Rockefeller family, or as a Russian prince.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Matthew Cox is a former mortgage broker from Florida who found himself on the Secret Service's most wanted list; he made millions falsifying homeownership and mortgage documents for five times the properties' actual worth.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Jan Lewan is the polka sensation from Pennsylvania who fleeced millions of investors with his classic Ponzi scheme; his name shot to fame when Netflix produced the movie "Polka King" with actor Jack Black playing Jan Lewan.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Nicknamed The Chameleon, Frédéric Bourdin is a former French serial imposter who claims to have faked at least five hundred false identities, including a young Texas boy who went missing in the mid-90s.

programme.desc: Shaun Greenhalgh is a British artist and art forger; between 1989 and 2006, he produced a number of forgeries including Roman and Chinese art objects, and medieval Christian relics, that fooled some of the world's most respected art institutions.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Dubbed the "Mini Madoff," Kiener is one of Germany's greatest con artists, tricking thousands of private investors and banks, including Barclays and J.P. Morgan, to the tune of more than $300 million.

programme.title: American Heart

programme.title: Overland Riders
programme.desc: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: Tornado Range
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his partner, Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), escort homesteaders into Texas to settle. Determined to resist the settlement, rancher Lance King (George Chesebro) organizes the locals, despite both the caution of his daughter, Mary (Jennifer Holt), and a government document delivered by Eddie assuring the homesteaders of their rights. As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
programme.desc: Gunslinger and former Confederate Jim Dancer (Randolph Scott) is on a mission to find his brother's killer but mistakenly shoots the wrong man, leading him to become an outlaw. Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Range Beyond the Blue
programme.desc: A stagecoach operator in the untamed territories of the American Southwest, Margie Rodgers (Helen Mowery) becomes a target for bandits when she starts hauling gold. Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation.

programme.title: Border Feud
programme.desc: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: Frontier Fugitives
programme.desc: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: Man From Oklahoma
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Twilight in the Sierras
programme.desc: Parole officer Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) visits his kindhearted friend Judge Wiggins (Edward Keane) at his home for rehabilitated ex-convicts. Behind the judge's back, foreman Matt Brunner (George Meeker) has been running a counterfeiting ring with the unwilling help of former prisoner Ricardo Chavez (Russ Vincent). An accident during a lion hunt causes Deputy Sheriff Pat Callahan (Dale Evans) to arrest Roy for murder, while Brunner's henchmen kidnap Chavez's visiting sister (Estelita Rodriguez).

programme.title: In Old Amarillo
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid
programme.desc: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. He rides into the town where the murder took place, but there Sheriff Landon (Edward Cassidy) warns him against vigilantism. This doesn't stop Tom from pursuing poker player Honest John (I. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Coming home at the end of World War I, Matt Brady (John Payne), the black-sheep brother of big-city political boss Tim Brady (Roy Roberts), is a loose cannon who gets into drunken fights and impulsively marries a total stranger, the plain but kind-hearted Lorry (Gloria McGhee). Taking over his brother's political machine after Tim's sudden death, Matt becomes powerful and extremely wealthy, but his corrupt dealings with a local gangster (Robin Morse) threaten to destroy everything he has.

programme.title: Cloudburst
programme.desc: Canadian World War II veteran John Graham (Robert Preston) works in London as a code breaker. Tragedy strikes when his pregnant wife, Carol (Elizabeth Sellars), is accidentally run over by two crooks who are speeding away from the scene of a murder. Haunted, grieving and thirsting for revenge, Graham sets out to find the two fugitive murderers. When he does, he intends to kill them, the same way they killed Carol. But will that assuage his grief?

programme.title: Hell Bound
programme.desc: A gangster's consort (June Blair) and an ambulance driver (Stuart Whitman) become involved in a villain's (John Russell) plan to steal surplus war drugs.

programme.title: Crime Against Joe
programme.desc: Joe, an unemployed artist living with his mother, is suspected of murdering bar singer Irene Crescent during a drinking binge. His alibi -- that he ran into a sleepwalker and helped her home -- is denied by the sleepwalker's father. A friend, waitress Slacks, who is secretly in love with him, comes to his aid with a false alibi. When it doesn't hold up, Joe and Slacks must go in search of the real killer themselves.

programme.title: Chicago Confidential
programme.desc: A state's attorney (Brian Keith) nails a union leader (Dick Foran) for murder, then learns it was part of a mob frame-up.

programme.title: Portrait in Terror
programme.desc: An English killer (Patrick Magee) and a weird artist (William Campbell) plot to steal a painting in Venice, Calif.

programme.title: The Last Mile
programme.desc: A killer (Mickey Rooney) gets desperate with eight others on death row, then makes his move.

programme.title: The Wild Party
programme.desc: Embittered ex-NFL pro Tom Kupfen (Anthony Quinn) has taken to hanging with a group of go-nowhere beatniks, including good-schoolgirl-gone-bad Honey (Kathryn Grant), hopped-up jazz musician Kicks Johnson (Nehemiah Persoff) and ticking time bomb Gage Freeposter (Jay Robinson). Together they drink, dabble in drugs and commit just enough petty thefts to support their lurid lifestyle. But when a con they try to pull on a couple of squares goes sour, the hip crooks get in way over their heads.

programme.title: Alias John Preston
programme.desc: A small-town young man (Christopher Lee) rises in social standing, haunted by nightmares of murder.

programme.title: Curse of the Faceless Man

programme.title: The Black Tent
programme.desc: An Englishman (Donald Sinden) learns his army brother (Anthony Steel) married a Bedouin (Anna-Maria Sandri) and fought the Nazis as a guerrilla.

programme.title: The Big Boodle
programme.desc: Cuban crooks and police chase a casino card dealer (Errol Flynn) for counterfeit pesos and plates.

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Franz von Werra (Hardy Kruger) is a Luftwaffe pilot by trade, but an escape artist by necessity. When his plane is attacked over England, he initiates his first effort to break out of the POW camp only days after arriving. Transferred to a second, more secure facility, Franz nevertheless manages to tunnel out and very nearly steals an airplane before being recaptured. This time the Allies send him to be imprisoned in Canada, but he steadfastly insists that no cell will hold him.

programme.title: Beachhead
programme.desc: During World War II, four Marines land on a Pacific island to execute the rescue of French planter Bouchard (Eduard Franz) and his daughter, Nina (Mary Murphy). With Japanese soldiers hidden throughout the dense jungle landscape, the Marines face a daunting trek to reach their target and must endure even greater danger on the return trip with the two French citizens. In the end, one of the Marines, Burke (Tony Curtis), carries the responsibility of getting everyone to safety.

programme.title: Ten Seconds to Hell
programme.desc: After the end of World War II, six German soldiers return to Berlin and form a bomb disposal unit. Defusing bombs is extremely risky business, so every week the group contributes to a fund that will go to the last man standing. Only Karl Wirtz and Eric Koertner are left, and their once solid friendship is starting to crack. Adding to the tension is their rivalry over a local woman and one last job that could change everything.

programme.title: The Purple Plain
programme.desc: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again.

programme.title: Kings Go Forth
programme.desc: During World War II, in a picturesque town on the French Riviera, U.S. Army Lt. Sam Loggins (Frank Sinatra) and Cpl. Britt Harris (Tony Curtis) both fall for the same local girl, the American-born Monique Blair (Natalie Wood). But when the soldiers learn that Monique and her mother (Leora Dana) had moved to France from the United States to escape discrimination against her parents' interracial marriage, each man must examine his own bigotry and prejudices.

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: Because final peace negotiations are bogged down in political maneuvering, U.S. soldiers, led by Lt. Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck), are forced to assault entrenched Chinese troops. The site of battle is Pork Chop Hill, a daunting, desolate climb that gives the communist forces a clear advantage. Clash after deadly clash wears down the morale and readiness of Clemons' men, and when they ask for back up, command is neither willing to send reinforcements nor authorize a retreat.

programme.title: The Secret Invasion
programme.desc: When the Allies need expendable soldiers for a highly dangerous mission, they offer pardons to a group of criminals in exchange for their participation. Led by the brooding Maj. Richard Mace (Stewart Granger), the motley crew, including explosives expert Terence Scanlon (Mickey Rooney) and scheming tough guy Roberto Rocca (Raf Vallone), sets out to extract a defecting Italian general held captive in a Nazi-controlled area. As they get farther into German territory, the casualties start to rise.

programme.title: A Prayer for the Dying
programme.desc: Irish Republican Army member Martin Fallon (Mickey Rourke) rigs a bomb to destroy a British army convoy, but the plan goes wrong when the trucks allow a school bus to pass. Now, Fallon wants out. He's through killing for the cause, but in order to secure safe passage to the U.S., he'll have to take one more job: eliminating rival terrorist Krasko (Stanley Beard). programme.desc: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate.

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: In this classic Shakespearean story, long-time adversarial families the Capulets and the Montagues engage in a street brawl, which results in a decree declaring that the next conflict will be punishable by death. But during an opulent masked ball, young Romeo Montague (Laurence Harvey) falls in love with Juliet Capulet (Susan Shentall). With the family feud reignited, Juliet's cousin kills Romeo's friend, Mercutio (Ubaldo Zollo), placing the young lovers in grave danger.

programme.title: The Quiet American
programme.desc: During the 1950s, Thomas Fowler is a British journalist stationed in Vietnam to cover the growing unrest. While in the country, he begins an extramarital affair with a beautiful young Vietnamese woman, Phuong. However, their romance is interrupted by Alden Pyle, an idealistic American economist in Vietnam on an aid mission. When Pyle proposes to Phuong, Fowler accuses him of secretly dealing weapons.

programme.title: Trapeze

Mike and Tino have a shot at the big time, but the two men are driven apart by the scheming of Lola (Gina Lollobrigida), an Italian trampolinist.

programme.title: Cop Hater

programme.desc: Free spirit and prostitute Ilya (Melina Mercouri) lives in a Greek port city. Open and amiable, she makes friends often and easily. Homer feels that modern Greece is a shadow of its former self, and he believes that Ilya is a prime example of contemporary decadence. programme.title: Adventures of Kitty O'Day
programme.desc: Kitty O'Day (Jean Parker) is a switchboard operator at a busy hotel where her boyfriend, Johnny (Peter Cookson), also works. Suspicious about some strange noises, she sends Johnny to her employer's apartment, where Johnny finds the boss has been murdered. Kitty is determined to find the culprit, but the hotheaded Inspector Clancy (Tim Ryan) is also on the case, and, as more bodies pile up at the hotel, the police start to throw accusations at Kitty and her amateur crime-solving crew.

programme.title: Ladybug, Ladybug
programme.desc: The teachers and students of a countryside elementary school are thrown into a panic when an air raid siren goes off, warning them of an imminent nuclear attack. They are unaware that it has gone off by mistake, and separate the children into groups -- one of which is headed by the anxious Mrs. Andrews (Nancy Marchand) -- to take them home. Harriet (Alice Playten) invites her classmates into her family's bomb shelter, but tragedy strikes when she won't allow one of her classmates to enter.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: The Group
programme.desc: Eight young women from the Vassar College class of 1933 rush out into the world to find exciting lives, but discover nothing is quite as they dreamed. Rather than blazing trails in art, science and literature, the friends are each variously burdened with disappointing relationships, children, aging parents and unemployment. Kay Strong (Joanna Pettet), the center of the group, gradually loses faith in the promise of their lives and, as war approaches, becomes unhinged.

programme.title: The Sultan's Daughter
programme.desc: An American woos the daughter (Ann Corio) of an Arab (Charles Butterworth) who's defending his oil fields from Germans.

programme.title: Witness to Murder
programme.desc: From her window, Cheryl Draper (Barbara Stanwyck) sees a neighbor, Albert Richter (George Sanders), murder a young woman. When Cheryl goes to the police, they cannot find any evidence because Richter has hidden the body. Cheryl persists in her claims without evidence, leading concerned policeman Larry Mathews (Gary Merrill) to worry that she is becoming obsessed. After Richter becomes aware of Cheryl's accusations, he conspires to make it appear that she is insane.

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones
programme.desc: Two men (Robert Urich, Carl Weathers) of different races, who loathe each other, escape from a chain gang shackled together.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: Visit to a Chief's Son
programme.desc: When a Western anthropologist, Robert (Richard Mulligan), brings his son, Kevin (John Philip Hogdon), to Kenya to document an eclipse and a remote Masai tribe's reaction to it, both father and son are in for a serious case of culture shock. Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life.

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them.

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: Anna Lucasta has been walking the streets in San Diego since being thrown out of home, at 19, by her alcoholic father, Joe. She's estranged from her family, but when her father and brother-in-law see greedy potential in an arranged marriage to affluent Rudolph, Anna is called back home. Old wounds have hardly healed, though. Just as Anna starts to feel for Rudolph, Danny, an old friend, returns to make life difficult.

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: The court-ordered desegregation of an inner-city Los Angeles high school brings 60 white students into the predominantly African-American student body. African-American teacher Quincy Davis (Calvin Lockhart) reaches out to all his students, enticing Lerone (DeWayne Jessie) to advance his reading skills with racy paperbacks, protecting new student Douglas (Jeff Bridges) after a race-motivated beating and trying to quell a potential student strike led by the militant J.T. (James A. Watson Jr.).

However, her own personal disappointments have left her embittered, and she only offers encouragement to her adopted daughter, Netta. When Netta, a successful teacher, returns to visit the family, she may be the voice of guidance and hope Billie Jean desperately needs.

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily.

programme.title: Drum
programme.desc: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt.

programme.title: The Monkey Hustle
programme.desc: Slick Chicago street hustler Big Daddy Foxx (Yaphet Kotto) lives comfortably off petty confidence scams that he pulls with the help of loyal teenage acolytes Baby D' (Kirk Calloway), Tiny (Donn Harper) and Player (Thomas Carter). His business is jeopardized, however, when he runs afoul of neighborhood racketeer Goldie (Rudy Ray Moore). Their rivalry escalates until the threat of a freeway being built through their neighborhood obliges them to cooperate in order to fight city hall.

programme.title: Belle of the Yukon
programme.desc: A con man who has tried to turn over a new leaf, Honest John Calhoun (Randolph Scott) is the owner and operator of a dance hall in the north of Canada. John has hoped to evade both the police and his past, but his history catches up with him when his ex-girlfriend, Belle De Valle (Gypsy Rose Lee), appears in his venue as a member of a dance troupe. As John and Belle reunite, fellow entertainer Lettie Candless (Dinah Shore) also becomes infatuated with the suave businessman.

programme.title: Geronimo
programme.desc: Apache leader Geronimo (Chuck Connors) tires of battling American and Mexican troops, and decides to surrender his meager tribe. However, life on the San Carlos reservation is difficult, and the Apaches do not adjust well to becoming farmers. Geronimo is befriended by a schoolteacher (Kamala Devi), who tries to broaden his horizons, but corruption on the reservation forces him to take his band and head for the mountains, where the Apaches wage a doomed war against the white man.

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: Bat becomes the only remaining witness for the prosecution in an upcoming murder trial in Wyoming as the father of the accused man either intimidates or kills anyone able to testify.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: An old foe mysteriously bequeaths his casino to Bat; when Bat arrives in Shotgun Falls, Wyo., to claim the inheritance, he discovers he must deal with a crippling mortgage and a murderous marshal determined to take control of the property.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory

programme.title: Tombstone Territory

programme.title: Quincannon, Frontier Scout
programme.desc: Linus Quincannon (Tony Martin) quits the U.S. Army in protest at the slaughter of Native Americans. He becomes a frontier scout, and is sent on an expedition to look into the disappearance of a cargo of munitions. He's joined by the lovely Maylene (Peggie Castle), who wants to find out if her brother died in an attack on a faraway fort. In a savage environment of hostile American Indians and renegade soldiers, Quincannon searches for the truth, and Maylene falls in love with him.

programme.title: Blazing Guns
programme.desc: The governor sends the Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) to tame a cow town.

programme.title: The Iron Sheriff
programme.desc: When his son Benjie is accused of killing a stagecoach driver, Sheriff Sam Galt is convinced his boy is innocent. On a quest to clear his son's name, Galt spares no expense in hiring lawyers. While Galt's position as town sheriff raises suspicions of police misconduct, he makes it clear he won't stand in the way of the law. But that certainty is thrown into doubt when Galt goes on a search for the real murderer -- and makes a startling discovery.

programme.title: Rebel in Town
programme.desc: Bedloe Mason and his four sons ride into an Arizona outpost after robbing a bank. When they hear a gun go off behind them, one son immediately turns around and shoots to kill. But his victim turns out to be a young boy with a toy gun, so the Masons hightail it out of town, save for Bedloe's son Gray, who feels guilty and stays to see the kid buried. Yet Gray's presence only stirs up more trouble as the child's father, John, looks for violent revenge.

programme.title: The Law Rides Again
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) use a convict (Jack LaRue) to trap a crooked Indian agent.

programme.title: Robbery Under Arms
programme.desc: Two brothers join their father in Captain Starlight's (Peter Finch) bushranger gang in 19th-century Australia.

programme.title: A Dog's Best Friend
programme.desc: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd.

After Sam invests in a way station with his friend, Luke Ram (Mark Stevens), Trench and Whitman convince a band of Sioux warriors to attack the station. programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman) is a rich cattle rancher. He has a bad relationship with his wife, Melissa (Candice Bergen), whom he treats like a possession. While Brandt is away from home on a hunting trip, Frank Calder (Oliver Reed), a brazen outlaw, kidnaps Melissa and holds her for ransom. Frank, however, treats Melissa better than her own husband does, and before long she begins to develop feelings for him. When Brandt returns, he's enraged and vows to take violent revenge against Frank.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: Foolish life insurance salesman Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) commits his biggest blunder yet when he unwittingly offers a six-figure policy to notorious gunslinger Jesse James (Wendell Corey). Furious, his boss orders him to repurchase the policy. James, however, parries Farnsworth's attempts with ease, robbing and humiliating him. But when James' latest scheme pairs the patsy with the bandit's sweetheart, Cora Lee Collins (Rhonda Fleming), Farnsworth and Cora begin falling in love.

programme.title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
programme.desc: From worse to terrible -- Civil War veteran Matt Weaver (George Segal) arrives in New Mexico worn down from combat, only to discover his family plot has been requisitioned and sold by cutthroat property developer Sam Brewster. When Weaver attempts to reclaim his land, Brewster hires a reclusive gunman (Yul Brynner) to take him out. However, the gunman proves uncontrollable. He refuses to kill Weaver and instead tries to seduce his wife (Janice Rule), all the while wreaking havoc throughout town.

programme.title: Gunfighters of Abilene

programme.title: The King and Four Queens
programme.desc: The four McDade brothers stage a successful heist -- except that three of them are killed. When their wives and mother learn that only one of the young men survived with the loot, they are eager to find out which one. Slick traveler Dan Kehoe catches wind of this strange situation and decides to charm the women in hopes of eventually enjoying the spoils. Before long, however, the lonely females begin competing for Dan, disintegrating into a cut-throat battle royal for his heart.

programme.title: Westward Bound

With the help of a trio of virtuous U.S. marshals called the Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele), the honest ranchers tangle with the politicians' henchmen.
