programme.title: Live: Good Morning Football
programme.desc: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.sub-title: Smash Burger and Creamy Chicken with Mushrooms
programme.desc: Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.sub-title: Creamy Chicken Pot Pie and Chocolate Tiramisu
programme.desc: Jamie cooks a midweek traybake of roast veg and Camembert. He turns poached chicken into a creamy chicken & chive pie, serves up his easy green chilli salsa under sizzling butterflied prawns, and finishes it all off with decadent chocolate tiramisù.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt
programme.desc: Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: Cantina Culture and the Morning After?
programme.desc: Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course

programme.title: The Falcon Out West
programme.desc: Dashing private detective Tom Lawrence (Tom Conway) stumbles upon a curious crime: a man killed by rattlesnake venom. While it might be a common enough occurrence in Texas, it's a rarity in a New York City nightclub. Lawrence -- better known as "the Falcon" -- ventures out to the Lone Star State to get to the bottom of the mystery. At the dead man's ranch, Lawrence and the victim's girlfriend, Vanessa Drake (Carole Gallagher), discover a viper's nest of suspects, all of whom have motives.

programme.title: Tall Man Riding
programme.desc: A few years ago, Larry Madden (Randolph Scott) left his fiancée, Corinna (Dorothy Malone), after a run-in with her father, the wealthy landowner Tucker Ordway (Robert Barrat). After saving a man (William Ching) from a vicious attack, Larry learns he is actually Corinna's new husband, and that some of the locals are preparing to challenge Tucker's land ownership. When Larry decides to ride back into town and make a claim himself, he encounters a few unexpected obstacles.

programme.title: The Glass Key
programme.desc: In this slick updating of Dashiell Hammet's crime novel, political boss Paul Madvig (Brian Donlevy) falls for reform politician Ralph Henry's attractive daughter Janet (Veronica Lake), despite the caution of his best friend, Ed Beaumont (Alan Ladd). Paul's efforts to disassociate himself from the criminal underworld backfire, however, when he is accused of murdering Janet's disreputable brother, and a casino owner Paul had offended sends his sadistic thugs after Ed in revenge.

programme.title: All the President's Men
programme.desc: Two green reporters and rivals working for the Washington Post, Bob Woodward (Robert Redford) and Carl Bernstein (Dustin Hoffman), research the botched 1972 burglary of the Democratic Party Headquarters at the Watergate apartment complex. With the help of a mysterious source, code-named Deep Throat (Hal Holbrook), the two reporters make a connection between the burglars and a White House staffer. Despite dire warnings about their safety, the duo follows the money all the way to the top.

programme.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
programme.desc: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Cuando me sonreís
programme.desc: Una comedia romántica que cuenta cómo la vida de Gastón Murfi un exitoso promotor musical, soltero codiciado, apuesto, metódico, ordenado y con una fobia a relaciones duraderas cambia con la aparición de su padre Juan a quien dejó de ver cuando era un adolescente, la llegada de un hijo que desconocía su existencia y ante el amor que se le presentará ante sus ojos pero que el mismo se encargará de negarlo, con la llegada al barrio de una nueva vecina llamada Luna quien instala un bar junto a su hermana Mili.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.title: Destinos cruzados
programme.desc: Toprak despierta de un coma tras cinco años sin recordar nada de su pasado, y regresa a una familia que no reconoce, incluida su prometida de toda la vida y un niño que vive con él. Sin embargo, su amnesia lo mantiene en una incertidumbre constante.

programme.title: Los datos son los datos
programme.desc: Un espacio de análisis que presenta debates de temas de actualidad y entrevistas a personalidades clave.

programme.title: Noticentro edición estelar

programme.title: Lo sé todo
programme.desc: El mejor equipo de entretenimiento mezcla el humor con investigación, además de entrevistas a artistas invitados, se realizan denuncias sociales y políticas y también hay espacio para la última información de la farándula.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.desc: Antes de su muerte, un científico revela a su ayudante la fórmula incompleta de un sensacional descubrimiento: una sustancia que vuelve pacíficos a los más belicosos. programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

Now they must con and fight their way across the west through thousands of cavalry, lawmen, bounty hunters, and Indians to make their escape.

programme.desc: EPS 13.

programme.title: 太陰指 / Finger of Doom
programme.desc: 故事描述，路天保與兩個結拜兄弟，巧遇奉師命清理門戶的躺棺長髮少女與四行屍人...

programme.title: 梁山伯與祝英台 / The Love Eterne
programme.desc: 祝英台女扮男裝入學堂求學，並與同窗梁山伯結下至死不渝的深情厚愛。山伯得知英台真實身份後，立即前往祝家提親，豈料英台早已被許配他人，二人被迫含淚分離。山伯因悲痛過度，一病不起，最終含恨離世。英台驚聞噩耗，悲痛欲絕，哭祭山伯墳前，更縱身躍入墓中，以身殉情。.

programme.title: 武館 / Martial Club
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻與天壽武館之王隱林年少氣盛，得罪陸正甫武館少主及其騁用的高手單雄，從而掀起武館間的正面衝突。本片是劉家良導演最得意的作品，更是1981年十大賣座電影之一。.

programme.title: 八國聯軍 / Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: 清朝末年政局腐敗，社會民不聊生，慈禧太后與一群愚昧無知的權貴大臣不但毫無抵禦外國列強侵佔，以及保護人民的能力，反而迷信以吞符唸咒，自稱無堅不摧的「義和團」可以抵禦洋人，決意向列強宣戰。結果導致八國聯軍攻陷北京，慈禧太后倉惶逃難；人民這才醒悟到，只有孫中山先生領導的革命运動，才是挽救中國的唯一希望。.

programme.title: 錦衣衛 / Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: 明朝時，英宗昏庸無能，大權落入劉永飾的宦官之手，他利用锦衣衛誅殺異己；然梁家仁飾的锦衣衛統領卻義釋忠良。其父在宦官脅迫下被迫追殺親子...

programme.title: 香江花月夜 / Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: 本歌舞片由聲色藝各有千秋的何莉莉、鄭佩佩及秦萍合演三姊妹，再配以三大小生淩雲、陳厚及嶽華大鬥演技。由日本名演導井上梅次執導.

programme.title: 痳瘋怪拳 / The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: 鐵橋三發覺林縣官與鎮南醫局主持孟平勾結販毒，被追殺，幸得漁家女採嬌所救。採嬌乾爹醉公公介紹鐵到歐陽洪的雜貨店送貨，因而認識酒樓夥計老鼠仔。林與孟查知鐵下落，欲加害鐵，反而使歐陽洪無辜被害。鐵逃入海幢寺，得玄光大師傳授五郎八卦棍，遂與老鼠仔往找孟平報仇….

programme.title: 燕娘 / The Swordmates
programme.desc: 李飛龍要出行送鏢，行前囑咐好友王天彪代照顧自己的鏢局及妻兒，不料，天彪竟先誘姦飛龍之妻子，後殺鏢局眾徒，更伏兵襲擊飛龍一行人等。飛龍死裏逃生，請師侄英傑往保護女兒燕娘...

programme.title: 踩綫 / Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: 本片由著名演員王鍾編導，為 1981年的社會寫實電影。故事描述，呂良偉與李修賢在片中均為中越混血兒， 由越南逃至澳門；呂於香港出生，可在港居留，乃與李分散；鄭則仕飾呂之叔父，為一幹練警探，即介紹呂加入員警世界，派其作臥底。後鄭一次與越南匪徒糾鬥中 遭殺害；而李則被牽涉入這宗凶案...

programme.title: 寶蓮燈 / The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事，講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘，二人一見鍾情，結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨，屢遭迫害，二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後，聞悉生母被壓華山，悲憤欲絕，藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神，劈山救母。.

programme.title: 萬箭穿心 / Oath Of Death
programme.desc: 馬慶庭、向獨步、金梁義結金蘭，專與元軍作對。馬假意歸附元朝，獲封鳳陽鎮威大將軍，向、金火速進城，途中遇少婦沈衣霞，向娶之為妻。金催馬對元人採取行動，馬卻藉詞拖延。後來馬竟與沈有染，馬將向圍殺於城外，並冠以江洋大盜之名。金設計「萬箭穿心」，誓為向報仇…….

programme.title: 楊貴妃 / The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: 唐明皇十分寵愛妃子楊貴妃，導致終日尋歡作樂，荒廢國事，更將所有國事交貴妃之兄丞相楊國忠處理。丞相卻因貪贓枉法，暴虐無道，引起軍民共憤。民眾乘機造反要弒唐明皇，貴妃自知難逃一死，於是最終投繯自盡。.

programme.title: 流氓千王 / Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: 宗華與李修賢飾賭術精湛的流氓千王，李在澳門賭場被陳萍飾的千后擊倒後，遂回港與宗合作一雪其恥，出千騙財，開設豪華賭場，欲將陳誘得入局….

programme.title: 死角 / Dead End
programme.desc: 故事描述，狄龍與姜大衛游車河時，遇富家女李菁的跑車拋錨，狄載她返家，一見鍾情。後李往姜之修車廠取車，再遇狄，狄約李去跳舞，夜總會中，碰見李兄陳鴻烈，陳不喜歡狄，故二人只好提早離去；歸家途中，目擊員警追捕逃犯，逃犯掉下之手槍，被狄檢到，從此改變他的命?..

programme.title: 死角 / Dead End
programme.desc: 故事描述，狄龍與姜大衛游車河時，遇富家女李菁的跑車拋錨，狄載她返家，一見鍾情。後李往姜之修車廠取車，再遇狄，狄約李去跳舞，夜總會中，碰見李兄陳鴻烈，陳不喜歡狄，故二人只好提早離去；歸家途中，目擊員警追捕逃犯，逃犯掉下之手槍，被狄檢到，從此改變他的命?..

programme.title: 萬人斬 / Killer Constable
programme.desc: 清朝光緒年間，守衛森嚴的大內金庫，竟遭悍匪劫去黃金二萬兩，慈禧太后大為震怒。外號「萬人斬」的京都捕房總捕頭冷天鷹受命於三個月內，緝捕匪首方逢甲歸案。方逢甲佈署大批匪徒喬裝村民，向冷天鷹施以突擊，冷在猝不及防下終告受傷。失明少女方蘭姑讓冷在屋內養傷，未幾，方逢甲突然出現，原來蘭姑乃其獨女...

programme.title: 降頭 / Black Magic
programme.desc: 狄龍劇中為一準新郎，但卻遇上心術不正的恬妮單戀癡纏，更借助邪術降頭，務求奪取男方歡心。後恬妮裙下之臣羅烈及狄龍未婚妻，亦相繼加入戰團。一場因為愛而生與死的鬥爭，複雜的關係加上正邪大鬥法，將人性為達一己私慾的惡行，表露無遺。至於邪是否不能勝正？且看結局便有分曉。.

programme.title: 洪熙官 / Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: 清廷走狗白眉道人焚毀少林寺後，繼續追捕殘存的少林弟子。洪熙官在逃亡期間遇見了方詠春，兩人墜入愛河結為夫婦，並育有一子名為文定。洪熙官最終被白眉所殺，文定決心融合父母遺留下的武藝，創立虎鶴雙形拳，以報父仇。.

programme.title: 怪俠 / The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: 怪俠江丹楓全家都被土匪殺害，遂誓必殺盡此等敗類。一次，江殺土匪沙如虎，沙臨終時哀求江將遺物交予其妹秀秀，江允之；秀得知兄為江所殺，憤然拔刀將他砍傷，但她又後悔傷江，因其兄罪應該死，遂留江在家養傷，但江的行蹤已被盜首黃天霸發現..

programme.title: 乾隆皇君臣鬥智 / The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: 翰林院大學士劉墉機智多謀，口才了得，常難倒乾隆。乾隆心中不忿，欲設計刁難他，但劉墉人急智生，妙語如珠，反令乾隆又再語塞。.

programme.title: 隱身女俠 / Shadow Girl
programme.desc: 年輕女劍客服下奶奶研製的隱身藥後，變成白天隱形晚上現身的怪人。她無意中搗亂了黑道首領女兒的婚事，惹來連番追殺。女劍客最後如何脫險？.

programme.title: 牛鬼蛇神 / Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: 軍閥割據時代，江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮，「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣，反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。.

programme.title: 飛龍斬 / The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: 奸相秦權病重，危在旦夕，派手下爭奪長生籐。護衛司馬駿與「九指魔女」沙沙向藥師處取藥被拒，便殺死了藥師。師弟鐵二郎盜走了長生籐，司馬駿追殺鐵二郎，兩人展開了生死決鬥。.

programme.title: 奪棍 / The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: 一天，絕代棍王紅鷹被惡霸擄走，徒弟阿檬誓要救出師父。途中，阿檬遇上雖貪財，卻武功了得的朱頭炳。在阿檬的利誘下，朱頭炳決定一同出發營救紅鷹。即使二人南轅北轍，但最終仍合力與惡霸終極一戰。.

programme.title: 星際鈍胎 / Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: 美麗但無知的李天珍被外星人捉上飛碟，事後無人相信她曾與外星人接觸。於是，當她打算一死以示清白之際，卻遇上同有輕生念頭的失敗私家偵探伊電。二人互吐心聲後改變主意，卻遭遇一連串奇遇，而二人的愛情故事也因此開始。.

programme.title: 大俠沈勝衣 / Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: 武林中人對白家珍藏的「唐門火冊」虎視眈眈，後更揚言要擄劫其女。大俠沈勝衣於是建議以其情人煙飛代白家小姐，並尋出個中玄機...

programme.title: 花木蘭 / Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: 花木蘭因父親年事已高，毅然女扮男裝替父從軍，對戰匈奴。她英勇善戰，屢立奇功，更被擢升為大將軍。木蘭衣錦還鄉，為家族贏得了無上的榮光。元帥欲將女兒許配給她的時候，才得知她是女兒身。.

programme.title: 明月刀雪夜殲仇 / Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: 天下第一快刀傅紅雪為報父仇，萬里尋兇，途中七名兇手竟逐一離奇暴斃。傅紅雪與好友葉開追查真相，卻發現七人根本未死，一切皆是幕後主使「千面人魔」蕭別離操縱佈局，誘傅墮入圈套。葉開挺身相助，二人卻雙雙身陷刀陣，處境岌岌可危。.

programme.title: 紅樓夢 / Dream of the Red Chamber(1961)
programme.desc: 這部電影改編自中國史上最廣受歡迎的文學作品《紅樓夢》，被譽為同名電影中最成功的作品。樂蒂生動地詮釋了美麗卻帶有一絲哀愁的林黛玉角色，也因此贏得了「古典美人」的美譽。.

programme.title: 紅樓夢 / Dream of the Red Chamber(1961)
programme.desc: 這部電影改編自中國史上最廣受歡迎的文學作品《紅樓夢》，被譽為同名電影中最成功的作品。樂蒂生動地詮釋了美麗卻帶有一絲哀愁的林黛玉角色，也因此贏得了「古典美人」的美譽。.

programme.title: 龍虎會風雲 / Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: 故事描述，金兵侵入，身負重傷的未國將軍囑其女、羅烈及張佩山飾的的愛徒，保護太上皇玉璽，不斷出計，最終難免決一死戰...

programme.title: 風花雪月 / Moods Of Love
programme.desc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計，著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還，被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去，遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還；玉華無奈，只好踏上母親所走過之路...

programme.title: 水晶人 / Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: 故事講述，龍飛精心雕琢的水晶美人像忽然失蹤後，多名黑道高手離奇被殺，江湖傳言乃水晶人變成精靈殺人之所為。龍飛經過連番追蹤後，終發現水晶人乃日後訓練之殺手。水晶人揭發江湖廝殺之真正幕後人，實為偽裝王爺的天帝...

programme.title: 殺手三分半鐘 / The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: 職業殺手雷振華在尖東某夜總會成功殺死黑道名流四哥等人後，悄然來到馬來西亞並住進唐人街對面一舊式旅館。唐人街的豪華酒店裡正舉行一個盛大婚禮，新郎石先生正是雷計畫用三分半鐘解決的目標，不料，未等雷下手，另一殺手已捷足先登，倒在地上卻是另一要人，雷頓時成了替罪羊。.

programme.title: 女殺手 / The Lady Professional
programme.desc: 女殺手被組織控制，強逼去殺商界名人石英，險中殺人滅口的陷阱。她不想淪為殺人工具，決心進行報仇大計，故事曲折離奇...

programme.title: 花街時代 / My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: 少女美麗為謀生來到灣仔酒吧當吧女，自此淪落風塵。其後，美麗在酒吧認識占美，深深愛上他，並確定自己已找到真愛。當占美要離開的時候，傷心的美麗即陷入低潮，直到遇上黑幫頭目王英才有了倚靠。.

programme.title: 爛頭何 / Dirty Ho
programme.desc: 青年俠盜何真看上歌妓翠紅，翠卻已被京城富豪王親勤包起；王武功高強，深藏不露，實為康熙皇帝第十一子喬裝；王見何為人率直重義氣，且盜亦有道，故何雖多番放肆，王亦不以為忤；何本為官府通緝犯，王卻暗中助其脫身；王此舉無非望何改邪歸正，但何不知收斂，王遂以計制之；後四太子為奪取皇權，把兄弟一一谋殺，特派梁將軍谋殺王，何遂出手相助...

programme.title: 乾隆下江南 / The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: 乾隆為體察民情，撇下侍衛假扮商人微服出訪江南，期間得知衙門有貪官欺壓百姓，導致民不聊生。這時乾隆遇上一名清廉的賣菜青年，二人合力教訓貪官一頓。最後，青年更被獲封為皇帝的近身侍衛。.

programme.title: 大決鬥 / The Duel
programme.desc: 得知弟弟殺死黑社會頭目後，唐人杰毅然承擔罪責，成為殺手追殺的目標。在江南浪子的協助下，他終於成功復仇，卻驚覺江南浪子正是殺害父親的真兇。.

programme.title: 寒煙翠 / Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: 陳詠薇的父母準備離異，於是把她送到章家暫住。章家長子凌霄、次子凌風、三女凌雲和年輕畫家余亞南都對詠薇很好，使她在章家農場度過了難忘的暑假。.

programme.title: 水滸傳 / The Water Margin
programme.desc: 此片是張徹導演的史詩式武俠鉅作。宋朝官府被貪官污吏和土豪劣紳控制，於是宋江帶領一百零八位英雄義士齊集梁山。這羣實力非凡的英雄好漢，形成了一股強大的武裝勢力，一場梁山好漢與官府的大戰就此展開。.

programme.title: 弟子也瘋狂 / Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: 方世玉、洪熙官與胡惠乾三位俗家弟子初入少林，拜於南院戒嗔大師門下習武。然而，三人常與出家弟子悟清較勁切磋，寺中從此喧嚷不絕，連方丈見此情景亦不免啼笑皆非。.

programme.title: 小煞星 / The Singing Killer
programme.desc: 強宜本是夜總會歌星，後來為尋初戀女友水仙的下落，被人帶到匪幫的木屋。原來，強宜少年時誤入歧途，有打劫殺人的犯罪紀錄，綽號「小煞星」。一哥要脅他共同打劫珠寶行，否則公開他的秘密。強宜假意應承，從長計議。想不到當日行動踏入珠寶行，發現售貨員竟然是初戀女友水仙！.

programme.title: 女子公寓 / Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: 故事背景為一幢女子公寓，房東陳太太痛恨男人，嚴禁男性進入，不幸，女房客卻多靠男性而活；歌女尤淑文由台北飛到香港，找尋失蹤的妹妹；尤經作曲家王德生介紹到居所樓上之女子公寓居住...

programme.title: 女子公寓 / Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: 故事背景為一幢女子公寓，房東陳太太痛恨男人，嚴禁男性進入，不幸，女房客卻多靠男性而活；歌女尤淑文由台北飛到香港，找尋失蹤的妹妹；尤經作曲家王德生介紹到居所樓上之女子公寓居住...

programme.title: 請帖 / Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: 青年俠士辛酸得悉王爺擬委託四大殺手押送神秘箱子往西安，且將付出十萬兩銀子作酬金，辛遂殺四人及持其頭顱往見王爺，求接辦保鏢事，蓋辛欲得該筆巨額酬金作賑災之用，王爺允之。辛途遇妙手怪丐楊風、無形劍客古非天及美豔女俠水仙花等高手截劫。原來當中牽涉通敵叛國的陰謀...

programme.title: 銷魂玉 / Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: 王致和無意得到通靈玩意，許下三個願望，雖然願望靈驗之極，結果落得家散人亡；風塵女孟薇被情人林坤全害死，變成水鬼復仇；豔麗女子蕭雲玉香消玉殞後，仍不斷在人間走動，盜墳贼欲挖開蕭雲玉墳墓盜取陪葬珠寶，終被蕭雲玉追殺致死...

programme.title: 死囚 / The Condemned
programme.desc: 流浪漢馮大剛被誤指為劫匪，遭逮捕後關押於死囚牢。真正的劫匪為了滅口，賄賂獄中扒手楊靈對馮大剛下毒手。楊靈明白馮大剛是冤枉的，於是暗中設法幫助他逃獄。誰料逃獄計劃意外失敗，最終兩人反而成為真正的死囚。.

programme.title: 花田錯 / The Bride Napping
programme.desc: 故事講述千金小姐劉月英與丫鬟春蘭同遊花田盛會，邂逅橋邊畫畫的落拓書生卞濟。春蘭眼見小姐芳心暗許，於是穿針引線，欲促成良緣，卻因老家僕錯認小霸王周通為卞濟，使小姐與卞濟情路波折重重。在經過一連串誤會與錯配後，結局乃皆大歡喜。.

programme.title: 飛刀手 / The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: 綽號飛刀追魂的焦雷與乾坤劍名手于遠結怨，焦要追殺于全家。幸得飛刀手楊青救了于的女兒于英；但楊青生性風流，向于英開出對付焦雷的條件是共渡一夜。于英憎惡他，又不得不和他一起助父親與焦雷決鬥。相處日久，于英才明白楊非登徒浪子，實對她深愛非常。.

programme.title: 七仙女 / A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: 故事描述少年董永賣身傳員外家，為奴以埋父骨；其孝心感動了七仙女，便幻成村姑，在六位仙姐下凡暗助下，為董縮減償還工作日，回復自由後，二人回董故家，但愉快的凡間生活能持續多久呢？.

programme.title: 幪面大俠 / That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: 漢高祖死後,呂后專權,密詔太尉設法殺死代王劉恆。幪面大俠發現其詭計後，馬上告知劉恆。劉於是急遣護衛保護公主往長安求援。太尉率大隊軍馬沿途追殺公主,幸得幪面大俠保護,處處化險為夷。最後，幪面大俠更助劉恆成功繼承漢室大統。.

programme.title: 何日君再來 / Till the End of Time
programme.desc: 富家子卓明不顧父親反對，與歌女雪玲結婚，並因此與家庭斷絕關係。婚後，雪玲懷孕，卓明因過度勞累導致視力衰退。為維持家計，雪玲重操舊業登台演唱，而卓明不願拖累妻子，選擇悄然離開。在友人鼓勵下，雪玲再次公開獻唱，卓明深受感動，最終與妻兒重逢。.

programme.title: 滿天神佛 / Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: 一次驅鬼時，青年術士魯興與友人因功力太差被女鬼戲弄險告喪命，幸得連大師施法幫助，才將女鬼驅逐。於是二人馬上拜他為師。友人意外地被日本忍者所殺，魯興決定要學習絕世茅術，與大師一起對付殘暴的忍者，因而引發終極亂鬥！.

programme.title: 青春萬歲 / The Singing Escort
programme.desc: 青年歌手趙克仁被夜總會老闆委托，到日本尋找他的女兒秋婷。克仁在日本遇到了少女花子、表妹荔萍、女歌手蘇珊、以及冒認是秋婷的女子。克仁愛上了蘇珊。當老闆親自去日本，便認出了蘇珊就是他的女兒秋婷...

programme.title: 海軍突擊隊 / The Naval Commandos
programme.desc: 故事描述二次大戰日軍侵佔上海，中國海軍力量薄弱，難以跟日艦抗衡；為保存戰力，在長江布下水雷，將一艘魚雷快艇偽裝成漁船，乘夜突襲...

programme.title: 乾隆皇與三姑娘 / Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty

programme.desc: Yuni sudah pasrah dengan jodoh hingga membuat permintaan yang ditulis di kertas dalam botol dan dilemparkan ke sungai. Benny yang menemukannya membuat Yuni kesal karena sebelumnya pernah terlibat pertengkaran di jalan. Yuni pun menolak membantu Benny dan berakhir penuh kesialan.

programme.title: Halu Sama Mas Tour Guide, Resiko Tanggung
programme.desc: Viola (Larasati Nugroho) pekerja keras, cantik, dan baik hati memiliki seorang kekasih bernama Tomi (Jorgie Kasenda) berselingkuh. Pada hari ulang tahun Tomi, Viola yang akan memberikan kue ulang tahun, dikejutkan dengan melihat Tomi yang sedang berselingkuh dengan wanita lain. Viola yang mengetahui bahwa ia bukan anak kandung dari wanita yang dipanggilnya Mama, berusaha mencari kakak kandungnya yang terpisahkan. Hal tersebut membuat Viola hijrah ke sebuah desa yang sejuk. Saat bekerja di puskesmas, Viola bertemu dengan seorang pria bernama Aris (Lavicky Nicholas).

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Kalo Rocker Juga Manusia Kenapa Aku Disia-Sia?
programme.desc: Kala pemuda rocker yang bermimpi menjadi musisi harus hidup di suasana desa karena dikirim oleh sang Ayah. Namun ia bertemu dengan Asih gadis desa cantik anak dari penjaga villa yang Ayah Kala miliki. Kala pun kepincut dengan sosok Asih yang memilik paras cantik dan memiliki hati yang baik.

programme.title: Istilah Kata Mah Saling Cosplay Jadi Pacar Aja
programme.desc: Terus menerus di desak oleh orang tuanya membuat Arya nekat mau mengutarakan isi hatinya pada Diana, tapi ternyata Diana malah dijemput pacarnya. Hancur hati Arya. Arya akhirnya berpikir untuk berpura-pura memiliki pacar. Arya teringat Dinda, penjual bunga yang selalu bersemangat. Arya pun mendekati Dinda dan menawarkan kesepakatan yang menurutnya sangat menguntungkan.

programme.title: Duduk Tenang Rayuan Gen Z Datang
programme.desc: Cinta yang tiba-tiba dideketin sama brondong nih namanya Roy, Gen Z banget deh anaknya! Apakah gombalan Roy bisa sampai ke Cinta

programme.title: Dunia Ini Pahit, Yang Manis Hanya Neng Teh
programme.desc: Adit dikirim ke desa lantaran Ayahnya yang meninggal dan bangkrut dan ia mewasiatkan agar Adit tinggal di desa dan bertemu dengan sahabat Ayahnya. Di desa Adit pun bertemu Yuna gadis desa yang cantk bekerja sebagai penjual teh talua keliling, yang tak lain adalah anak sahabat Ayahnya. Selama di desa Adit ikut Yuna berkeliling untuk berjualan teh talua dan keduanya pun makin akrab. Lantas akankah keduanya saling jatuh cinta

programme.title: Ketika Waktu Bermain-Main Dengan Cinta
programme.desc: Alami kecelakaan dan menjadi amnesia, Salma tak sadar bahwa ia sudah tiga tahun menjalani pernikahan dengan Wisnu dan dikaruniai seorang anak. Namun saat ingatannya pulih, Salma justru tak mengakui Wisnu dan masih mencintai pria yang ia sukai tiga tahun lalu. Lantas seperti apa kisahnya?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan

programme.title: Takut Banget Ketempelan Mba Telur Ayam
programme.desc: Naya Gadis muda pekerja keras yang cantik tersebut bekerja sehari-hari di peternakan telur dan menyuplai telur ke toko-toko. Meski pekerjaannya berat dan bukanlah pekerjaan yang bergengsi, tapi Naya melakukan tugasnya dengan penuh rasa bahagia. Pada suatu hari,Naya masuk ke sebuah toko langganannya yang memesan telur ayamnya. Tanpa sengaja menabrak Aldo yang sedang terburu-buru hingga akhirnya telur yang dibawa oleh Naya jatuh ke lantai. Aldo yang berpenampilan rapi dan klimis seperti layaknya para pekerja kantoran. Aldo marah karena bajunya yang bersih terkena noda telur ayam yang pecah akibat ulah Naya yang ceroboh.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Preman Pensiun Deui
programme.desc: Pensiunnya Bahar (pemimpin preman) dan kekacauan yang terjadi di wilayah kekuasaannya setelah ia menyerahkan urusan pada tangan kanannya, Muslihat, yang kemudian mencoba mengambil alih, memicu konflik dengan anak buah seperti Jamal dan Komar, memaksa Bahar turun tangan lagi untuk menyelesaikan masalah dan mengembalikan ketertiban, seperti kasus tanah di kampung dan penahanan Jamal.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Terlanjur Mencintaimu Arumi (Rr)
programme.desc: Arumi, seorang barista keliling pekerja keras, menikah dengan Rendi, namun kemudian mengetahui bahwa pria itu sudah beristri dan hanya memanfaatkannya demi mendapatkan pewaris. Sempat mengira bayinya telah meninggal, ia akhirnya mengungkap kebenaran dan menemukan harapan baru bersama Elio.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Mencintaimu Sekali Lagi Arini (Rr)
programme.desc: Arini, seorang penata rias sukses yang digemari para selebritas papan atas, mengalami patah hati saat memergoki kekasihnya berselingkuh dengan sahabatnya sendiri. Sempat kehilangan kepercayaan pada cinta, ia bertemu dengan Lingga yang perlahan memikat hatinya. Namun, masalah muncul ketika Emil, saudara laki-laki Lingga, juga jatuh hati padanya.

programme.title: Go Spot Eksklusif
programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Film dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan selama moment liburan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji

Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Microdrama + : Studio Cinta
programme.desc: Clara, gadis yatim piatu yang dilarang bermimpi, diam-diam menari di sanggar yang mengurungnya. Segalanya berubah saat Kevin hadir dan melihat bakatnya, memicu kecemburuan dan rahasia kelam masa lalu. Ketika kebenaran terungkap, Clara harus memilih: menyerah pada luka, atau menari merebut kembali hidup dan cintanya.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Anugerah Cinta (Rr)
programme.desc: Ayah Naura meninggalkan beban utang bagi keluarganya, yang membuat Naura dan Oki pergi ke Jakarta untuk mencari uang. Di sana, Naura bertemu dengan Arka dan mereka pun jatuh cinta, hingga akhirnya hadir orang ketiga dalam hubungan mereka.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Selafaz Cinta
programme.desc: Reza terkejut mendengar voice note yang mengandungi suaranya dan Liza, yang mengaku perbuatannnya terhadap Liza. Reza pelik Ditto sanggup jual maruah isterinya sendiri. Jannah risaukan Jasmin kerana Mokhtar banyak muslihat.

programme.title: Selafaz Cinta

programme.title: Mat So'od
programme.desc: Mat So'od merupakan penglipurlara di kampungnya. Namun berlawanan dengan kerjayanya, Mat So'od merupakan seorang pemurung hampir sepanjang hidupnya.

programme.title: Perkahwinan Dari ...
programme.desc: Pasangan selebriti terkenal di Malaysia, Asha dan Mal terdesak untuk menjaga rahsia perkahwinan mereka dari diketahui oleh pengurus mereka, Feek.

programme.title: Kipas Belum Mati
programme.desc: Mia, seorang artis meningkat naik, membuka kelab peminatnya dan dibantu oleh Lynn yang menjadi pengurus. Dengan bantuan Lynn, kelabnya maju namun ada harga yang harus dibayar di sebalik kejayaan tersebut..

programme.title: Geng
programme.desc: Isabella is an ex-convict who has sworn off her life of crime. Unfortunately, her old gang boss wants her to do one last drug transaction and kidnaps her mother to blackmail Isabella. With the help of her high school best friends, Mariam and Anita, Isabella goes on a road trip to save her mother.

programme.title: Keabadian Cinta
programme.desc: 3 couples falls in love with each other in 3 different love stories.

programme.title: Boyfriend Aku Dari ...
programme.desc: After being disappointed multiple times, Risya is introduced by a friend to Andy, a nerdy young man. They fall in love but in actuality, Andy is a boyfriend from 'hell'!

programme.title: Gengster Leng Chai
programme.desc: Black is a failure of a gangster, being too soft hearted with people. After meeting Mawar, he is determined to change despite the objections of others.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap Sesat Kat Paris
programme.desc: Nini and Haikal start their big adventure to find their aunty Lisa who gets a job offer as a professional photographer in Paris. Unfortunately, their journey turns upside down when they arrive in Paris and ruin a newly-wed coupleís honeymoon.

programme.title: Nota Silam
programme.desc: Munirah menjumpai sebuah nota cinta di dalam sebuah buku yang diperolehi secara rambang dari 'blind date with a book' dan cuba untuk menemukan pasangan di dalam nota tersebut yang merubah hidup Munirah

programme.title: Bukan Cerita Cinta Cliche
programme.desc: Seorang penulis skrip kisah-kisah cinta tetapi masih bersendirian mengimpikan cinta dalam kehidupan realitinya, lalu dia menyertai sebuah kumpulan terapi untuk berkongsi masalah peribadinya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: A doctor's (Jerry Orbach) teenage daughter (Jennifer Grey) gets slinky with the dance teacher (Patrick Swayze) at a Catskills resort in the summer of 1963. Starring Jennifer Grey, Patrick Swayze, Jerry Orbach.

programme.title: Black Sails
programme.desc: Vane is threatened by Flint; Eleanor picks a side; Rackham learns what Max can do; Silver rejoins an old friend.

programme.title: Black Sails
programme.desc: Miranda tries to save the island; Eleanor opens old wounds; Rackham sniffs around a big secret; Vane deals with a problem.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: A killer stalks North Carolina teens (Jennifer Love Hewitt, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Ryan Phillippe) who disposed of an auto accident's live victim. Starring Jennifer Love Hewitt, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Ryan Phillippe.

programme.title: Blood Quantum
programme.desc: The dead are coming back to life and almost all of Earth's population is decimated due to a zombie virus, except for the isolated Mi'kmaq reserve of Red Crow, whose indigenous inhabitants are strangely immune to the zombie plague. Starring Michael Greyeyes, Elle-Maija Tailfeathers, Forrest Goodluck.

programme.title: The Other Half
programme.desc: A woman with bipolar disorder and a grief-stricken man struggle to forge a simpler life. Starring Tom Cullen, Tatiana Maslany, Suzanne Clément.

programme.title: Fire
programme.desc: Unhappy in their marriages, two New Delhi wives (Shabana Azmi, Nandita Das) find solace and love in each other's arms. Starring Shabana Azmi, Nandita Das, Kulbhushan Kharbanda.

programme.title: Step Dogs
programme.desc: Meatball, a wise cracking country dog, and Cassie, Hollywood's most pampered pet, meet when their owners get married. The two fight constantly until burglars break into their house, and they must team up to protect their home. Starring Dylan Schmid, Brittney Wilson, Eliana Jones.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: A lovable dog must rely on some new friends to help it break out of canine prison and get back home to his owners. Starring Jeff Foxworthy, Rob Schneider, Frankie Quiñones.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Yogi (Dan Aykroyd), Boo Boo (Justin Timberlake), and Ranger Smith (Tom Cavanagh) team up to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers. Starring Dan Aykroyd, Justin Timberlake, Anna Faris.

programme.title: The Iron Giant
programme.desc: A malevolent government agent threatens to destroy the friendship between a boy and a huge alien robot. Starring Jennifer Aniston, Eli Marienthal, Harry Connick Jr..

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: While transporting a usually docile Abnormal, Magnus's helicopter crashes, leaving her and Will stranded in the shaft of an abandoned oil rig; they soon find they are not alone in the water.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: While an old friend of Magnus', a pouched abnormal named Jimmy, is handing over a fire elemental to the Sanctuary team, they are attacked by a gang of criminal abnormals from Chicago; the situation presents a lot of mysteries to be solved quickly.

programme.title: The Cable Guy
programme.desc: An act of kindness brings a jilted architect the unwanted friendship of an unbalanced cable-TV installer. Starring Jim Carrey, Matthew Broderick, Leslie Mann.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Now the parapsychologists (Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd) are trying to rid New York of stress-related pink slime. Starring Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Sigourney Weaver.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, four women (Melissa McCarthy, Kristen Wiig, Leslie Jones, Kate McKinnon) prepare for an epic battle as mischievous ghosts start to wreak havoc in New York. Starring Melissa McCarthy, Kristen Wiig, Leslie Jones.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, four women (Melissa McCarthy, Kristen Wiig, Leslie Jones, Kate McKinnon) prepare for an epic battle as mischievous ghosts start to wreak havoc in New York. Starring Melissa McCarthy, Kristen Wiig, Leslie Jones.

programme.title: The Craft
programme.desc: Teen misfits befriend a suicidal newcomer and strike back at their tormentors with witchcraft in Los Angeles. Starring Robin Tunney, Fairuza Balk, Neve Campbell.

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
programme.desc: Freddy Krueger, a badly burned boogeyman with razors on his glove, haunts and kills teens in their dreams. Starring John Saxon, Ronee Blakley, Heather Langenkamp.

programme.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood
programme.desc: Ellen finds herself a guest among unexpected company; Brian and Murtagh attempt a daring rescue; Colum waits for news of the war; Henry makes an ally of a former enemy.

programme.title: Tip Toe
programme.desc: A showdown in the suburbs as Leo and Clive go face to face for the ultimate confrontation, while George goes to the heart of Manchester to explore his secret life.

programme.title: Fugitive Pieces
programme.desc: A writer (Stephen Dillane) has trouble moving past his haunting memories of the Holocaust. Starring Stephen Dillane, Rade Serbedzija, Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: Clara
programme.desc: In a race to find intelligent life in the universe, an astronomer and his freethinking research assistant make an inexplicable discovery that changes how they see the world -- and each other. Starring Patrick J. Adams, Troian Bellisario, Kristen Hager.

programme.title: Milton's Secret
programme.desc: A man (Donald Sutherland) teaches his 11-year-old grandson (William Ainscough) how to cope with bickering parents and the neighborhood bully. Starring Donald Sutherland, Michelle Rodriguez, Mia Kirshner.

programme.title: Muppets From Space
programme.desc: After learning about his origins, Gonzo must decide whether to seek his own kind or stay with friends. Starring Jeffrey Tambor, F. Murray Abraham, Rob Schneider.

programme.title: Nancy Drew and the Hidden Staircase
programme.desc: Modern, smart, and independent, Nancy Drew reluctantly befriends Helen, the local mean girl, and together they investigate the haunting of Twin Elms. Starring Sophia Lillis, Linda Lavin, Sam Trammell.

programme.title: Twilight
programme.desc: A high-school student is caught up in a romance with a vampire, whose family has renounced the drinking of human blood. Starring Kristen Stewart, Robert Pattinson, Billy Burke.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: New Moon
programme.desc: After the abrupt departure of Edward, her vampire love, Bella finds comfort in her deepening friendship with Jacob Black. However, Bella's loyalties are put to the test as she becomes drawn into the world of werewolves, ancient enemies of vampires. Starring Kristen Stewart, Robert Pattinson, Taylor Lautner.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Eclipse
programme.desc: Bella must choose between Edward and Jacob amid a string of mysterious killings and a malicious vampire's quest for revenge. Starring Kristen Stewart, Robert Pattinson, Taylor Lautner.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 1
programme.desc: A chain of events, set off by Edward and Bella's marriage, honeymoon and birth of a child, yields a shocking development for Jacob. Starring Kristen Stewart, Robert Pattinson, Taylor Lautner.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 2
programme.desc: Bella and Edward gather werewolves, vampires and other allies to help them protect their daughter from the Volturi. Starring Kristen Stewart, Robert Pattinson, Taylor Lautner.

programme.title: BloodRayne
programme.desc: A vampire hybrid joins the fight against the evil bloodsucker who sired her. Starring Kristanna Loken, Michael Madsen, Michelle Rodriguez.

programme.title: I Am Legend
programme.desc: After a man-made plague transforms Earth's population into vampires, a lone survivor desperately searches for a cure. Starring Will Smith, Alice Braga, Dash Mihok.

programme.title: The Perfect Story
programme.desc: Foreign correspondent Michelle Shephard helps young Somali refugee Ismael Abdulle escape his homeland and settle in Harstad, Norway. When he returns to Mogadishu years later, an unexpected turn of events changes everything.

programme.title: The Beast
programme.desc: When a militia plots a coup against the President, he has to quickly learn how to use all the offensive abilities in his armored limousine. Starring Samuel L. Jackson, Guy Burnet.

programme.title: Topper Takes a Trip
programme.desc: The ghosts of socialite Marion (Constance Bennett) and her dog, Skippy, help Cosmo Topper (Roland Young) with his wife (Billie Burke) on the Riviera. Starring Constance Bennett, Roland Young, Billie Burke.

programme.title: The Snake Pit
programme.desc: A man (Mark Stevens) commits his wife (Olivia de Havilland) to a mental hospital, where her doctor (Leo Genn) tries the latest therapy. Starring Olivia de Havilland, Mark Stevens, Leo Genn.

programme.title: Suddenly, Last Summer
programme.desc: A New Orleans matriarch (Katharine Hepburn) tries to bribe a brain surgeon (Montgomery Clift) to lobotomize her niece (Elizabeth Taylor) who witnessed a murder. Starring Elizabeth Taylor, Montgomery Clift, Katharine Hepburn.

programme.title: Torture Garden
programme.desc: Sideshow mystic Dr. Diablo (Burgess Meredith) shows an Edgar Allan Poe fan (Jack Palance) and other after-hours patrons their futures. Starring Jack Palance, Burgess Meredith, Beverly Sassoon.

programme.title: From Beyond the Grave
programme.desc: The sinister owner (Peter Cushing) of a London antiques shop leads customers into four tales of terror. Starring Peter Cushing, Margaret Leighton, Ian Bannen.

programme.title: Kwaidan
programme.desc: Japanese ghost stories from tales by Lafcadio Hearn include a samurai (Rentarô Mikuni) who wakes up with a corpse (Michiyo Aratama). Starring Rentarô Mikuni, Michiyo Aratama, Tetsurô Tanba.

programme.title: Three Cases of Murder
programme.desc: A trilogy of strange tales features too-real art, a crime of passion and a man who seeks revenge through deadly dreams. Starring Alan Badel, Orson Welles, Emrys Jones.

programme.title: Painted Desert
programme.desc: Hugh buys the deed to the Banning mine, and sells it to Bob when he thinks it is worthless. When he learns the mine is full of tungsten, he sets out to get it back. Starring George O'Brien, Laraine Day, Ray Whitley.

programme.title: Powdersmoke Range
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers (Harry Carey, Hoot Gibson, Guinn Williams) fight a gambler and his henchmen for a ranch. Starring Harry Carey, Hoot Gibson, Guinn "Big Boy" Williams.

programme.title: Yellow Dust
programme.desc: A prospector goes undercover to clear his name of robbery before he can lay claim to a mother lode of gold. Starring Richard Dix, Leila Hyams, Moroni Olsen.

programme.title: The Arizonian
programme.desc: A marshal, trying to end lawlessness and protect his brother and sweetheart, fights it out with a gang of crooks. Starring Richard Dix, Margot Grahame, Preston Foster.

programme.title: Cimarron
programme.desc: Husband-and-wife homesteaders (Richard Dix, Irene Dunne) join the Oklahoma land rush of 1889 and stay on to build an empire. Starring Richard Dix, Irene Dunne, Estelle Taylor.

programme.title: Ghost Valley
programme.desc: A crooked judge (Mitchell Harris) unwittingly hires the heir to a gold mine to scare his cousin (Merna Kennedy) into selling the property. Starring Tom Keene, Merna Kennedy, Mitchell Harris.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Awkward Annie (Barbara Stanwyck) loves her sharpshooting rival (Preston Foster) in Buffalo Bill's Wild West Show. Starring Barbara Stanwyck, Preston Foster, Melvyn Douglas.

programme.title: Scarlet River
programme.desc: An actor (Tom Keene) on the set of a cowboy movie rescues a rancher (Dorothy Wilson) from her foreman (Creighton Chaney). Starring Tom Keene, Dorothy Wilson, Lon Chaney Jr..

programme.title: Carl Laemmle
programme.desc: The extraordinary life story of Carl Laemmle, the German-Jewish immigrant who founded Universal Pictures and saved over 300 Jewish families from Nazi Germany.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Baron Frankenstein creates a monster from cadavers and a killer's brain. Starring Colin Clive, Mae Clarke, John Boles.

programme.title: The Invisible Man
programme.desc: The serum that makes a scientist (Claude Rains) invisible has madness as a side effect. Starring Claude Rains, Gloria Stuart, Henry Travers.

programme.title: The Black Cat
programme.desc: Stranded Budapest honeymooners follow a mad doctor (Bela Lugosi) to a black-lipped architect's (Boris Karloff) Art Deco manor. Starring Boris Karloff, Bela Lugosi, David Manners.

programme.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
programme.desc: Corrupted by a lord (George Sanders), Oscar Wilde's London aristocrat (Hurd Hatfield) stays young, but his portrait begins to age. Starring George Sanders, Hurd Hatfield, Angela Lansbury.

programme.title: The Beast With Five Fingers
programme.desc: A crawling hand chases a late concert pianist's personal secretary (Peter Lorre) around an Italian villa. Starring Robert Alda, Andrea King, Peter Lorre.

programme.title: Cat People
